title: Appointment Setter - Instagram DMs (High-Ticket Fitness)
description: Read this before applying: this is a sales role. You will spend your day in conversations. This is not content editing, caption writing, video editing or general VA work. If that's what you're looking for, this isn't it. ABOUT THE ROLE Reshape Coaching helps South Asian professionals transform their bodies without giving up the food they grew up on. 15 years in the industry, 2,000+ client transformations, clients across the UK, UAE and US. We sell 16-week and 6-month transformation programmes at £1,495–£2,495, with an ongoing coaching option after that. We're looking for an experienced and driven appointment setter to qualify leads and book calls. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Work the Instagram inbox: reply to inbound DMs, qualify people, and book discovery calls into the founder's calendar - Proactively open conversations with new followers and people engaging with our content - Follow up with no-shows and conversations that went quiet - Log every conversation and outcome in our tracker, daily. TARGETS You'll work to set weekly targets for booked calls, show rate and response time. Targets are agreed with you in your first week and reviewed monthly. Hit them consistently and there are bonuses on top of your normal pay. You'll be measured on booked calls that show up, not on messages sent. HOURS 4pm–10pm UK time, Monday to Friday, plus two flexible hours each day for outreach, follow-ups and admin. Weekend overtime is optional. For Philippines applicants, the live window is 11pm–5am your time (midnight–6am from late October, when UK clocks change). This is a night shift and we're not going to pretend otherwise — it's reflected in what we pay. That window is when our core UK audience is off work and on their phones, which is when the conversations happen. It isn't flexible. Please only apply if you can genuinely hold these hours long term. PAY Monthly base salary, plus commission on every sale closed from the calls you book. Paid monthly via Wise. Pay is reviewed at 3 months based on performance. WHAT YOU NEED - Prior experience setting appointments in DMs for a high-ticket offer (£1,000+). We'll ask for the offer, the price point and your numbers. - Written English good enough that our leads can't tell it isn't the founder writing. - The discipline to log your data every single day without being chased - A reliable internet connection and a backup plan for outages - A genuine interest in doing this long term. We train properly, and we'd rather train once. ADDITIONAL SKILLS - Experience setting appointments specifically in health and fitness - Familiarity with GoHighLevel, Typeform, Calendly and spreadsheets - Experience selling to a western South Asian audience Training and career progression are both real here. Our setter playbook is written, tested and handed to you on day one. HOW TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY - Do NOT apply through this website. Do NOT email. Apply the way you'd do the job. - DM us on ---------- - Your FIRST message must begin with the word 'SETTER' - Anything that doesn't gets deleted unread. - In that first message, include: - Your setting experience — the offer, the price point, and your monthly booked calls - Your rate expectations and your available hours in UK time - A link to your CV (Google Drive, Dropbox, anything — no attachments) - Then send a SECOND message. - A lead replies to one of our stories saying: "how much is your coaching?" - Send us your actual next message to them. Word for word, exactly as you would send it. One message. No preamble, no "here's what I'd say" — just send the message. - We reply to the ones who get it right within 48 hours. CLOSING DATE: 30th September 2026

title: AI Automation & Agent Engineer — Hermes, Workflows & Content Systems ($800–$2,500/mo)
job_title: AI Automation & Agent Engineer — Hermes, Workflows & Content Systems ($800–$2,500/mo)
description: WHO WE ARE We're a U.S. company that runs multiple businesses and client accounts. Everything we grow is being rebuilt around AI agents, automations, and systems that ship without babysitting. Long-term role, direct to ownership, remote. THE ROLE We're hiring an AI Automation & Agent Engineer — someone who pushes agent stacks (Hermes-style agents and similar), converts messy business processes into automations, and builds content/ops systems that run on a cadence. This is NOT a WordPress job. You may never open WordPress. This is NOT data entry, NOT social posting, NOT "I use ChatGPT sometimes." You take a brief, stand up agents / workflows / sites or tools when needed, and leave something that actually runs. WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO AGENTS & AI OPS (core) - Build, run, and improve Hermes-style agent setups (and similar agent platforms): skills, routing, overnight jobs, handoffs between agents - Use modern AI coding / agent tools daily — we pay for the monthly plans (Claude, Kimi, GLM, Cursor, etc.). You do not buy expensive subscriptions yourself - Treat the harness around the models as the product: multi-step agents, evaluators, retries — not one-shot chat BUSINESS → AUTOMATION - Take real business workflows (leads, booking, follow-up, publishing, reporting, ops) and turn them into reliable automations - GoHighLevel, n8n, Make, Zapier, webhooks, APIs — whatever fits; the point is converting the business, not clicking around once - Clean up messy client or internal systems and leave documented, maintainable flows CONTENT SYSTEMS - Content engines that ship on a schedule (think blog-a-day + image-a-day style pipelines): generate, QA, publish, optimize media - Prompt systems and batch pipelines — not one-off posts WEB / TOOLING WHEN NEEDED - Ship landing pages, internal tools, or site rebuilds when the brief calls for it — modern stacks welcome (Next.js, Vercel, headless, etc.) - WordPress is optional, not the bar. We care that you ship fast with AI, not that you live in Elementor - SEO, performance, and image optimization when you're touching sites — still AI-assisted, still systems-minded WHAT WE PROVIDE - Paid AI / agent tool access (monthly plans covered) - Infra budget as needed (hosting, automation platforms, model spend) - Direct briefs from ownership — no middle-manager layer - Long-term work across our businesses and clients - Upside: strong performers lead and bring on junior builders WHAT WE DON'T WANT - WordPress-only developers with no agent / automation depth - Pure VAs, data entry, or social-media-only applicants - "I prompt ChatGPT" with no shipped systems - Generic AI cover letters with no links, no Loom, no proof HOW TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY First line of your application must be exactly: APPLY-SEP2026-AIOPS Then include ALL of: 1) Three proof links — GitHub (commit history), live tools/sites, or Looms of agents/automations you built. 2) One agent or multi-step AI system you've run (Hermes, Claude Code, Cursor agents, custom agents, overnight jobs — describe the harness, not vibes). 3) One business process you turned into an automation (trigger → steps → result). Agency / multi-client is a plus. 4) One content or ops pipeline you've owned (publishing cadence, image pipeline, reporting, etc.). 5) Strongly preferred: 60–90 second Loom (screen share, your voice) walking through #2 or #3. 6) Monthly rate inside $800–$2,500, hours/week, time zone, daily overlap with U.S. Eastern. We watch honest applications. We delete fluff with no proof. BONUS (NOTICED) - Real Hermes (or similar always-on agent) experience - GoHighLevel automation builds that replaced manual ops - n8n / Make / Inngest / webhook architectures - Video / media pipelines (Seedance, fal.ai, FFmpeg) if you've touched them - Supabase, Vercel, Cloudflare, API integrations - GitHub activity in the last 30 days DETAILS - Full-Time (~40 hrs/week) - $800–$2,500/month DOE - 3–4 hours U.S. Eastern overlap required daily - Remote (OnlineJobs.ph / Philippines-friendly) AFTER SUCCESS: - Save screenshot /workspace/onlinejobs-shots/posted-v2.png - Write /workspace/onlinejobs-post-result.md with: action taken (edited vs remade), old ID status, new public URL, new job ID, title, pay - Report success yes/no, URLs, any blockers

title: QA / Test Engineer
description: To be considered, you must fill out the application form below: ---------- About the role We're a fast-growing telehealth company, and we're looking for a QA / Test Engineer to own product quality end to end. You'll test features before they ship, own our release process, and keep our bug backlog under control so the team can move quickly without compromising quality. This is a hands-on role that goes beyond manual testing. You'll own the path from "code complete" to "safely released" across our web and mobile products. What you'll do • Run end-to-end tests on new features before release across our web and mobile applications. • Own the release process: test staging builds, run the final quality gate before ship, and help us move toward faster, more frequent releases. • Develop risk-based test plans for critical telehealth workflows, including patient-facing experiences, privacy-sensitive functionality, and high-impact production changes. • Perform mobile device testing on Android, including reproducing and verifying device-specific issues. • Triage, track, and manage bugs, driving them to closure and keeping the backlog under control. • Partner with engineering and product to define test coverage and prioritize issues. • Build and maintain automated tests to expand coverage and speed up regression testing. What we're looking for • Solid QA / software testing experience, ideally in a fast-moving product environment. • Experience writing and improving test automation and test infrastructure, including using AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) to build and improve automation. • Hands-on Android device testing experience. • Comfortable testing web applications end to end. • Experience working across dev, staging, and production environments and with release processes. • Strong bug tracking, test case management, and triage skills. • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the judgment to distinguish release-blocking issues from minor ones. • Able to drive quality independently while partnering closely with engineering and product. Nice to have • Healthcare or telehealth experience. • Familiarity with mobile device management (MDM). • Experience helping a team move toward a continuous release cycle.

The ideal candidate is a highly intelligent, motivated individual who is passionate about leveraging technology to make a difference in healthcare. We're looking for someone who can bring fresh perspectives, adapt quickly to new challenges, and contribute to our innovative and fast-paced work environment. title: Video Editor (YouTube & Short-Form Media)

Retention & Pacing Mechanics: Deep understanding of YouTube audience retention, dynamic hooks, visual pacing, and fast-paced vertical video formats. Audio & Color Precision: Strong grasp of audio leveling, SFX placement, and clean color grading. High-Agency Drive: Ability to take creative direction, adhere to brand guidelines, organize project files, and proactively suggest creative editing ideas. COMPENSATION & SCHEDULE Hourly Rate: $5.00 – $7.00 USD / hour (commensurate with portfolio strength and editing speed). Flexible Part-Time Schedule: 20 hours per week with flexible working hours built around fixed delivery milestones. Reliable Payments: Fast, predictable weekly processing via Wise. 100% Remote: Work from the comfort of your dedicated home office setup. HOW TO APPLY We hold our team to high standards of detail and quality execution. To submit your application, please complete the following steps: Email Subject Line: Set your email subject strictly to: Video Editor - Your Full Name Workflow Scenario Assessment (Text Response): In 2–3 brief sentences, answer this scenario: If raw footage is uploaded and needs to be edited within a tight 1.5–2 hour window, how do you prioritize your workflow to maintain quality control, and what scope of editing can you realistically deliver? File Compression: Explain your exact process/settings for reducing the file size of short video clips without sacrificing audio and visual quality (e.g., preferred codecs, bitrate targets, export settings, or compression tools used). Application Package: Include a single Google Drive or iCloud link (permissions set to "Anyone with the link can view") containing: Portfolio Links: Direct viewable links showcasing your best long-form YouTube edits and short-form vertical clips. Updated Resume Tech Specs & Internet Speed Screenshots: Showing 16GB+ RAM (if lower, state in your text response if upgradable) and primary/backup internet speeds. Workspace & Backup Power Proof: Clear photos of your quiet home office setup and your backup power system (UPS, power station, generator, or solar).

title: Experienced Outbound Cold Email Specialist
description: We are looking for an experienced Outbound Cold Email Specialist to join our growing brand. The primary focus of this role is to identify relevant prospective clients and initiate high-quality, personalised conversations through cold email outreach. This is not a mass-emailing role. Every email must be researched, bespoke and relevant to the individual recipient or business. The successful candidate will understand how to use research, personalisation and strong written communication to generate genuine interest and qualified opportunities for our sales team. Key Responsibilities - Research and identify suitable prospective clients, including interior designers, architects, property developers, contractors, bathroom fitters, plumbers and other relevant trade and commercial customers. - Research each prospect and their business before making contact. - Write personalised cold emails tailored specifically to the recipient, their company and the type of projects they undertake. - Ensure emails feel individually written rather than generated from generic templates. - Clearly communicate why our products or services may be relevant to each prospect. - Manage structured follow-up sequences for prospects who do not initially respond. - Follow up previous conversations and potential leads generated through outbound activity. - Maintain accurate records of prospects contacted, follow-ups and outcomes. - Continually improve messaging based on response rates, engagement and the quality of opportunities generated. - Identify new customer segments and prospecting opportunities that could be relevant to the business. - Hand over interested prospects and positive responses to the sales team for further discussion and conversion. Experience Required Applicants must have: - A minimum of 2 years' proven experience in B2B cold email outreach or outbound email prospecting. - Demonstrable experience generating leads and conversations through cold outbound email. - Experience managing follow-ups and nurturing prospects who may require multiple points of contact before responding. - Strong written English and the ability to write concise, natural and professional emails. - Strong online research skills and the ability to identify meaningful information that can be used to personalise outreach. - Experience working with CRM, prospecting or email outreach platforms. - A good understanding of email deliverability and responsible outbound email practices. Experience targeting interior designers, architects, developers, construction companies, property professionals or trade customers would be particularly beneficial. What Success Looks Like We are NOT looking for someone whose primary objective is simply to send the highest possible number of emails. Success will be measured by the quality and relevance of outreach, positive response rates, qualified opportunities generated and the consistency of follow-up. The objective is simple: identify businesses that could genuinely benefit from working with us, approach them intelligently and personally, and create qualified conversations for our sales team. Once a prospect responds with genuine interest, our sales team will take responsibility for progressing and closing the opportunity.

title: Media Buyer for Amsterdam Real Estate (Meta + Google Ads)
job_title: Media Buyer for Amsterdam Real Estate (Meta + Google Ads)
description: We are ApartmentHub, a real estate agency in Amsterdam. We rent out and sell apartments in one of the most competitive housing markets in Europe, and we are expanding to Utrecht. We are hiring one media buyer to own paid acquisition end to end. This is not a "boost the post" job. We already have leadforms, a WhatsApp funnel, our own CRM and an engineering team. What we do not have is one person who owns the ad accounts and is judged on cost per real deal, not on cost per click. THE NUMBERS, SO YOU KNOW WHAT YOU ARE WALKING INTO We start at roughly 3.000 euro a month in ad spend, and it grows the moment you show it works. We are telling you this up front on purpose. If you are only comfortable at six figures a month, this is not your role. At our level you do not get to run twelve ad sets and let the algorithm sort it out. You get a few, you keep them out of the learning phase, and you make a modest budget produce real deals. Here is why that is still a great deal for you: our average closed deal is worth a few thousand euro to us. One extra deal a month already pays for the entire media budget. Get us three and you will have built yourself a much bigger budget to play with. Few media buyers get to see that link between their campaign and the invoice this directly. WHAT YOU WILL RUN - Meta lead campaigns for tenants, in Dutch and in English, feeding our own hosted leadforms - Click to WhatsApp campaigns. Almost every lead we get ends up in a WhatsApp conversation, so this channel matters more to us than a classic landing page - Meta and LinkedIn campaigns aimed at landlords and property owners. This is our highest value audience and it is almost untouched - Google Ads search on rental and selling intent, plus remarketing, and Performance Max only where it earns its place - A geo campaign for our Utrecht launch, on top of Amsterdam - TikTok and Instagram Reels ads built on our own video output - Retargeting across every audience we already own Selling and buying services are a channel we are opening, not one we are optimising. If you like being the first person to make a new revenue line work, that part is yours. MEASUREMENT IS HALF THE ROLE A lead is cheap. A signed deal is not. We want someone who closes the loop. - Meta Pixel plus Conversions API, Google Tag Manager, GA4, server side tagging where it is worth it - Offline conversion imports so the ad platforms learn from actual deals in our CRM, not from form fills - Realistic optimisation targets. At our budget you will not get the weekly event volume for value based bidding on closed deals, and we know it. We expect you to pick the highest quality event that still gets enough volume, and to use deal data for reporting, lookalikes and creative decisions - Consent and privacy done properly. We operate in the EU, so GDPR is not optional - Weekly numbers we can act on: spend, cost per lead, lead to appointment, appointment to deal, cost per deal, per channel and per audience WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO - Own the strategy, build, structure and daily optimisation of every ad account - Set and defend budgets. Move money to what works and switch off what does not, fast - Run a disciplined creative testing programme: hooks, angles, formats, audiences. At our budget that means testing inside a small number of ad sets and in sequence, not fifteen ad sets fighting each other for the same 100 euro a day - Brief our AI video creator and our UGC creators, and tell them exactly which angle to produce next based on what the data says - Write ad copy in English yourself. Dutch copy is translated and checked by our team, but you drive the message - Build landing page and leadform variants and test them, including qualification questions that filter out people we cannot help - Keep an eye on the funnel after the click: WhatsApp reply rates, appointment rates and drop off points - Deliver a weekly report and a monthly plan. Short, honest, with a recommendation WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT: YOU GET ENGINEERS We have an in house tech team and our own CRM built on Supabase. If you can describe what you need, we build it. Examples of what we can build for you: - Conversions API and offline conversion pipelines straight from our CRM, so deal value flows back into Meta and Google automatically - Automatic UTM tagging and lead source attribution all the way to the invoice - Live dashboards on our own data, so you are not stuck exporting spreadsheets - New leadform variants and landing pages built to your spec within days - Automated alerts on spend anomalies, rejected ads and broken tracking Your job is to buy media well. Our job is to make sure you never lose a day to plumbing. YOU ARE A FIT IF YOU HAVE - At least 3 years of hands on media buying, with Meta Ads as your deepest platform. This is a hard requirement - Real experience advertising to a European audience, in a previous job, not as a side project. This is a hard requirement and we will ask you which countries and for which company. Europe is not the US with different currency: consent banners change what you can measure, GDPR limits what you may store, the CPMs behave differently, and copy that shouts the way American ads do gets ignored here. We do not want to teach you that from scratch - The Dutch market is what we would really like to find. If you have run campaigns in the Netherlands, understood how Dutch people react to advertising, or worked with a Dutch company before, say so early in your application, because it moves you to the top of the list - Real Google Ads experience across search and remarketing. If Google is not your strongest platform, say so honestly and tell us what you have run - Managed budgets yourself, with full account access, not as a junior clicking inside someone else's structure. Size matters less to us than ownership. Someone who made 3.000 euro a month work beats someone who spent 100.000 without ever feeling the cost - Proven lead generation work. High ticket, considered purchases are a big plus. E commerce only is a weaker fit for us - Comfort with tracking: Pixel, Conversions API, GTM, GA4, UTM discipline - The instinct to question a good looking number. Cheap leads that never convert are a failure, not a win - Good written and spoken English, and the confidence to disagree with the founder when the data says so - Reliable internet, your own machine, and at least 4 hours per day overlap with Amsterdam time NICE TO HAVE - Real estate, property or relocation marketing - LinkedIn Ads and TikTok Ads - Experience with WhatsApp as a conversion channel, click to WhatsApp campaigns or a business messaging platform - Comfort with n8n, Make or simple API work - Basic understanding of SEO and how paid and organic feed each other WHAT WE OFFER - A competitive salary that matches your level, paid on time, every time. We agree the number together once we have seen your work - Full time, long term. We are building a team, not filling a gig - Two audiences with very different economics, two cities, two languages, so the work does not get boring - Real ownership of the ad accounts and the budget, with a direct line to the founder and no agency layers - An engineering team that removes your busywork - Full access from day one: your own seat on the ad accounts, the analytics, the CRM data and the dashboards. Nothing is kept behind the founder. One detail we are open about: our Meta ad account sits under a partner business manager, so you get a user seat there rather than ownership. Everything else is ours and yours to run - Every tool you need is paid for by us, ad spend included. You never spend your own money HOW TO APPLY (READ THIS CAREFULLY, WE FILTER ON IT) Applications that skip these steps get deleted without reading. 1. Use this exact subject line: MEDIA BUYER - your first name - years of Meta Ads experience 2. Start your message with the word ZUIDAS so we know you read the whole post 3. Tell us the highest monthly ad spend you have personally managed, on which platform, and for what kind of business 4. Which European countries have you run ads in, for which company, and over what period? Name one thing about advertising in Europe that surprised you compared to other markets. If you have worked on the Dutch market, tell us here 5. Send one case study: the situation, what you changed, and the numbers before and after. Screenshots of Ads Manager are welcome, blur the client name if you have to 6. Answer in 3 sentences: a campaign brings in cheap leads but almost none of them turn into customers. What do you check first, second and third? 7. Answer in 2 sentences: how would you feed the value of a closed deal back into Meta and Google, and why does that change how the campaign performs? 8. Which do you know better, Meta or Google, and how big is the gap? An honest answer scores better here than a claim that you are equally strong at both 9. What is your monthly rate expectation in PHP, and are you available full time? Bonus that moves you straight to the top of the pile: look at our public channels, find one paid campaign angle we are clearly missing, and describe it in five sentences. Audience, hook, format, offer, landing point. We reply to every applicant who follows the steps above.

title: Creative Strategist & Direct Response Copywriter (Jewelry Brand)
job_title: Creative Strategist & Direct Response Copywriter (Jewelry Brand)
description: JOB DESCRIPTION You'll d ---------- what ads we make and why, and you'll write a large share of them yourself: hooks, video scripts, UGC briefs and ad copy. This is a hands-on role for someone who can read the data in the morning and write the winning script in the afternoon. ABOUT US We're a small, fast-moving e-commerce team based in the Netherlands, running direct-to-consumer brands with 4+ years of experience in paid social. We run a DTC brand, a "smart luxury" jewelry brand selling 18k gold-plated, waterproof and tarnish-free pieces to women 45+ in the UK. Meta is our main growth channel, and creative is our biggest lever. We test new ads every week, and we need someone to own the thinking and writing behind them. What you'll do - Analyse performance. Dig into Meta Ads data (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS) to understand which ads win and why. Find new angles. Mine customer reviews, post-purchase surveys, competitors and customer language for new hooks, angles and personas. - Write ads. Write hooks, video scripts, UGC and talking-head scripts, static ad copy and primary text in natural, persuasive British English. - Brief production. Write clear briefs for video editors, UGC creators and designers. - Plan testing. Plan the weekly creative testing roadmap: what we test, for which persona, and in which format. Iterate on winners. Turn one winning ad into ten strong variations with new hooks, formats, talent and angles. Report back. Share weekly learnings with the media buying team so the next batch is smarter than the last. Must-haves: Excellent written and spoken English. Native or near-native (C2) level. You write the way our customers talk, and you know the difference between British and American English. Direct-response experience. At least 2 years of writing DTC or e-commerce ad copy, with a portfolio of paid social ads you've written. Meta Ads fluency. You're comfortable in Meta Ads Manager and understand the key performance metrics. Strong hook writing. You know that the first 3 seconds d ---------- everything. Data-led judgement. You back creative decisions with numbers, not just taste. Speed and ownership. You can handle high volume without dropping quality. Nice to have: Experience writing for women 40+, jewelry, fashion or beauty. Familiarity with classic direct-response thinking (Schwartz, Hopkins, Ogilvy, Kennedy). Experience using AI tools for research, scripting or creative production. Experience with Meta Ads. Experience briefing UGC creators. What we offer - Real impact. Your ads go live within days, and you'll see exactly what they do for revenue. - Autonomy. You'll own the creative strategy for a growing brand. - Flexibility. Fully remote with flexible hours. - A direct team. You work straight with the founders; no layers, no bureaucracy. - Room to grow. As we scale, you can build out and lead a creative team. - Bonus on winning ads. Please send us your CV and information why this job is something for you!

title: Accounting/Account Receivable/Account Payable

Primary Responsibilities Financial Leadership * Lead all accounting and finance operations. * Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close. * Prepare executive financial statements and management reports. * Manage budgeting, forecasting, and long-range financial planning. * Develop cash flow forecasts and working capital strategies. * Analyze financial performance and recommend improvements. * Build executive dashboards and KPI reporting. * Identify opportunities to improve profitability and reduce costs. title: META Performance Marketing Exec
description: We operate two Singapore children’s-enrichment businesses: IntChess and Sportszilla. description: About Marie Originals Marie Originals is a US-based, multi-brand DTC and B2B wellness and personal-care company selling across Amazon, Walmart, Shopify, and TikTok Shop. Amazon is our biggest channel, and the catalog is the foundation everything else runs on. If a listing is suppressed, mis-classified, or out of stock on the wrong fulfillment channel, we lose sales that no amount of advertising can win back. We are hiring an Amazon Catalog Specialist to own that foundation across both FBA and FBM. This is a detail-heavy, systems-minded role. You will live in Seller Central and in flat files. WHAT YOU WILL OWN Listing creation and catalog builds - Create new ASINs and full variation families (parent/child) for product launches using Amazon category templates and flat files. - Manage GTIN/UPC assignment and exemptions, item type keywords, and correct browse node and category classification. - Maintain accurate attributes across the catalog (size, dimensions, materials/ingredients fields, pack quantity, compliance fields). FBA and FBM operations - Own both fulfillment channels: keep FBA and FBM offers correctly set up, in stock, and live on the right ASINs. - FBA: manage FNSKUs and labeling, build and track inbound shipment plans, clear stranded and unfulfillable inventory, file and chase reimbursement claims for lost or damaged units, and watch restock limits, IPI, and aged-inventory exposure. - FBM: maintain shipping templates, handling time, and availability so merchant-fulfilled offers stay competitive, and coordinate dispatch with our warehouse and ShipStation flow. - Protect the fulfillment metrics our listings depend on: late shipment rate, valid tracking rate, on-time delivery rate, and cancellation rate. - Flag which SKUs belong on FBA vs FBM and switch them when stock position or economics change. - Submit and follow up on FBA fee and dimension/weight disputes. Catalog health and troubleshooting - Monitor and fix suppressed, stranded, inactive, and incomplete listings, and get them live again fast. - Diagnose and resolve catalog defects: merged or split ASINs, duplicates, wrong category, overwritten content, and variation errors. - Open, escalate, and follow through on Seller Support and Brand Registry cases until they are actually resolved, not just closed. - Watch for unauthorized changes, listing hijacks, and content overwrites, and act on them. Bulk operations and data hygiene - Run bulk updates via flat files and inventory loader templates without breaking live listings. - Keep a clean, reconciled source of truth for SKUs, ASINs, and FNSKUs across our systems. - Audit the catalog on a regular cadence and close gaps before they cost us sessions or the Buy Box. Brand and content operations - Maintain Brand Registry, A+ Content modules, and the Brand Store, aligned to our approved copy and imagery. - Make sure images and detail-page content meet Amazon's requirements. - Coordinate with our listing SEO, advertising, and creative teams so the catalog supports what they are running. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR - 2+ years hands-on Amazon Seller Central catalog work for a brand or agency (beyond basic data entry). - Hands-on with both FBA and FBM: inbound shipment plans, FNSKU and labeling, stranded inventory and reimbursements on the FBA side; shipping templates, handling time, and tracking/on-time metrics on the FBM side. - Genuinely fluent with flat files, inventory templates, variation families, and bulk uploads. You have rebuilt a broken variation family before. - Track record recovering suppressed, stranded, and mis-categorized listings. - Comfortable driving Seller Support and Brand Registry cases to resolution. - Strong attention to detail, organized, confident in Excel or Google Sheets. - Clear written English, and you flag problems early instead of sitting on them. NICE TO HAVE - Brand Registry, A+ Content, and Brand Store experience. - Seller Fulfilled Prime or Multi-Channel Fulfillment (MCF). - Walmart Seller Center, Shopify, or other marketplace catalog experience. - Experience coordinating with a 3PL or in-house warehouse (we run ShipStation). - Wellness, personal-care, or supplement category experience and its documentation requirements. - Comfort using AI tools to speed up repetitive catalog work. DETAILS - Full-time, remote (Philippines). - Overlap with US business hours, as coordinated with your lead. - Compensation: Based on Experience. What was wrong, what you did, and how long it took to get it live or recovered. No ghosting, we reply to everyone.

title: Medical Care Coordinator & Program Accountability Coach — Eczema Practice (Long-Term, Medical Experience Required)
job_title: Medical Care Coordinator & Program Accountability Coach — Eczema Practice (Long-Term, Medical Experience Required)
description: Job overview: Type: Part-time, 22–24 hours a week, growing with us Pay: $7–9/hour depending on experience — 22–24 hours a week, roughly $665–855 a month Hours: 8:00am–12:00pm Pacific, Monday to Friday. Monday starts 2–4 hours earlier. Skills: Healthcare admin, excellent spoken and written English, careful and warm Please read this part first: I've posted a couple of roles recently and I'm replacing both of them with this one. I'd been looking for two people — someone to coordinate care, and someone separate to support our members week to week. Having talked to a lot of candidates, it's clear this should be one job. The person who books the appointments, sends the lab kits, and knows who hasn't collected theirs is the same person who should be reading our members' journals. Nobody coming to it cold could write anything useful. So this is one role, more hours, and a better job than either of the two it replaces. I'm also being much stricter about who I'm asking to apply, because I had far more applications than I could work through last time — most from people with no healthcare background. Please only apply if all three of these are true: You have medical or healthcare experience — nursing, medical technology, pharmacy, healthcare administration, medical VA work, or similar You can send a short video introduction, described at the bottom The night shift genuinely works for your life, long-term If any of those is a no, please don't apply. I'll only be reading applications that include the video and the writing sample, and I'd rather not waste your time. A strong plus: experience or study in nutrition, wellness, or functional health. If you applied to either of my earlier posts: this one replaces them both and I'm not working from those applications any more. If you meet the requirements above, please apply again here and follow all the steps at the bottom. I'll read it properly this time. About us: Hi — I'm Dr. Diane Angela Fong, a naturopathic doctor in California. I run Cleanbody, a practice and education program for people with severe eczema and other chronic diseases. Most of the people who find us have been struggling for years. They've tried steroids, elimination diets, and a dozen creams that didn't work. By the time they reach us they're exhausted and they've mostly stopped believing anything will help. We run lab testing to find what's actually driving their skin, then a twelve-week program to fix it. The program works — but only if people stay with it. And the hardest week isn't the first. It's week six, when their skin flares, they're discouraged, and nobody notices they've quietly stopped. This role has two halves. Most of the week you keep the practice running. On Mondays, you're the person who notices. Your week: Monday — 6 to 8 hours. You start earlier and work through to noon Pacific. Messages pile up over the weekend, so you clear those first, then move on to the journals. If you don't finish them, they carry into Tuesday — better done properly than done fast. Tuesday to Friday — 4 hours, 8:00am to 12:00pm Pacific. Coordination, callbacks, and any journals left over. In Manila time that's 11:00pm–3:00am from March to November, and midnight–4:00am from November to March. The two halves: Responsibility #1: Patient Care Coordination — every day You keep everything moving so I can focus on patients. Returning calls. We don't get many and most go to voicemail — your job is to call people back during the morning window. Appointment questions, kit questions, rescheduling. Scheduling and rescheduling Sending lab kits and tracking whether they've been collected and posted Chasing the people who haven't collected. This is the single most common reason someone's care stalls, and preventing it is worth more than almost anything else you'll do. Entering results into the chart when they arrive Documenting supplement refills Producing superbills on request Issuing and revoking member discount codes Answering routine questions by email — never clinical ones Responsibility #2: Accountability coaching — Mondays Our members keep a journal each week: how they slept, what they ate, whether they took their supplements, how their skin feels. They submit by Sunday night. Every Monday you read all of them and write back to each person. You tell them what they're doing well. You ask what's getting in the way. You remind them that week six is hard for almost everybody and that they're not behind. Then you send me a short report: anything I need to know, who's gone quiet, who's stalled, the three questions that came up most, and one win worth reading out. I use that report to plan the live call I run mid-week, so what you send me shapes what our members hear. I'll need that report by the end of your Tuesday shift. Why this is one job and not two: you already know this member's results came back last week, that they've reordered twice, and that they cancelled a visit in October. Someone reading their journal cold couldn't write anything specific. You can. The line you never cross: You are not giving medical advice. Not on the phone, not in writing, not in either half of this role. You never comment on symptoms, interpret a lab result, suggest a supplement, or answer a question about someone's protocol. That's my job and I'm the only one who can do it. I'll train you thoroughly on exactly where the line sits and give you approved wording for everything that comes up. Safe: "You've logged six hours' sleep for two weeks — what's getting in the way?" Not safe: "Your flare might be the eggs." or "Maybe try half the dose." You comment on what the person did, never on what their body is doing. This is harder on a call than in writing, because someone will ask you directly and you'll want to help. You'll have a scripted answer ready for exactly that. Anything urgent reaches me automatically through our system, so you are never responsible for catching an emergency. Your job is noticing patterns, not crises — that's a relief, not a restriction. What you need: Required: A medical or health background. Nursing, medical technology, pharmacy, nutrition, physical therapy, healthcare administration, or medical VA work. This is not negotiable — you'll be handling lab kits, results, and refill documentation, and you need to already understand what you're looking at. Clear spoken English. You'll be calling patients in the US, and they need to understand you easily the first time. Excellent written English — warm and natural, not stiff or formal Genuinely careful. In this work, small errors matter. Comfortable following a script and escalating rather than improvising A headset and a quiet room for calls. Not a laptop microphone, not a shared space. Reliable internet, and Mondays genuinely free — that's the day the week depends on Able to commit long-term. This role grows as we grow. Nice to have: Personal or family experience with eczema, or another chronic skin condition. This matters more than anything else on this list. If you've lived with it, or watched someone you love live with it, you already understand something I can't teach. Experience with an EHR or patient portal Nutrition, wellness, or functional health — study or work experience. You'll be surrounded by this material and it helps enormously to already speak the language. Social media or video editing. I publish a lot — YouTube, reels, a podcast — and if you can edit or schedule content, there's more work here for you and it's how this role grows fastest. Not required: Any US credential Availability outside the morning window Weekend or evening work — there is none What it's like to work here: We're small. We will be a two person team supporting our patients. I'm direct about what I need, I don't micromanage, and I would far rather you ask than guess. I'm expecting a baby in March 2027 and I'll be on leave from March to June. During those four months you'll be the main point of contact our members have. That's exactly why I want to hire and train someone properly now rather than scrambling in February — and it's why I'm looking for someone who wants a long-term role rather than a stopgap. There's a bonus in July 2027 for being here continuously through that period. I'd rather say that up front than hope. Pay: $7–9/hour depending on experience — 22–24 hours a week, roughly $665–855 a month Paid twice monthly, in USD 13th month bonus, as standard Paid 15-minute break each shift; 30-minute unpaid meal break on Mondays Pay is reviewed as you take on more, and there are more hours available over time — particularly if you can help with content or if our patient and membership base grows How to apply: Please don't send a generic application — I read every one myself and I can tell. My website is www.cleanbody.health if you want more information about my practice before you complete these items. Send me: 1. A short note about your background and why this kind of work appeals to you. Not your CV. 2. This writing sample. Here is a member's journal entry from their sixth week: "Honestly this week was rough. My skin flared up worse than it's been in a month and I don't know why. I've been doing everything — I haven't had dairy in five weeks, I'm taking all the supplements, I'm sleeping better than I was. And it still got worse. I'm starting to wonder if this is worth it. I skipped my journal a few days because I didn't want to write it down." Write your reply. Around 100–150 words. Remember: you're not a doctor. You cannot tell them why their skin flared, what to change, or whether the dairy is the problem. What you can do is notice what they've done, acknowledge how it feels, and help them keep going. 3. A short video — 2 minutes, no more. Just you talking to your phone camera. Tell me who you are and why you'd be good at this. It doesn't need to be polished; I'm not judging your lighting. I want to hear how you speak about people — and since you'll be calling patients, I need to hear you speak. If you or someone close to you has lived with eczema, tell me about that. It's the thing I most want to hear. 4. A subject line that starts with "ECZEMA" — then, in a few words, tell me why I should open your message. Not "ECZEMA - Application" or "ECZEMA - Care Coordinator." Something real. ECZEMA — nurse, 6 years, my son has had it since he was two. ECZEMA — medtech, I read lab reports all day and I write well. I'll be reading a lot of these. Your subject line is how you make sure yours isn't the one I skim. 5. Confirm the schedule works for you — 8am to 12pm Pacific, Monday to Friday, with an earlier start on Mondays. Tell me honestly whether nights suit your life. Applications without the writing sample and the video won't be read. I'm sorry to be blunt about it — I've had hundreds of applications on previous posts and this is the only way I can give proper attention to the right ones.

title: Content Assistant + Short-Form Video Editor
description: Part-Time, Ongoing | Remote // About the Role // I run House of Agalliao, a growing hair and beauty brand focused on custom wig making and wig education. I’m looking for a creative Content Assistant + Short-Form Video Editor who can help me turn the content I create into engaging, intentional social media content while also helping me become more organized and consistent with content creation. This is primarily an editing role, with content assistance as the secondary responsibility. I’m not looking for someone who only waits for instructions and completes tasks exactly as assigned. I want someone who can eventually learn the brand, understand my personality and creative preferences, help me develop a recognizable content style, and bring ideas to me too. You do not need to know everything about my brand or industry on day one. I’m looking for someone who is observant, creative, reliable and willing to learn. // Who I’m Looking For // You may be a great fit if you’re very online and naturally aware of what’s happening across Instagram, TikTok and internet culture in general. You understand current content trends, conversations, memes, sounds, editing styles and emerging formats — but you also understand that following every trend doesn’t automatically make good content. You should be a strong short-form video editor with a good eye for pacing, storytelling, text placement, music, sound effects, transitions and visual details. You should be comfortable editing Instagram Reels, TikToks and other vertical short-form content and be able to do basic photo editing or simple graphics when needed. I’m especially interested in someone who can see potential in raw footage that may not immediately look exciting. You should also be able to study another person’s personality and gradually understand their voice, sense of humor, preferences and audience. Good content should do more than look pretty. It should hold attention, communicate something and ultimately support the business. I want someone proactive enough to say: “I saw this trend and think we could adapt it this way.” Or: “You mentioned this while filming — I think that could actually be its own Reel.” Or: “For next week, I need you to record these three clips and I can turn them into these content ideas.” You should be organized, reliable with deadlines, consistent with communication, comfortable receiving feedback and capable of working independently once you have proper direction. I don’t expect you to know everything. I do expect you to be resourceful enough to research, experiment and figure things out. // What You’ll Help With // Your responsibilities may include: * Editing Instagram Reels, TikToks and other short-form videos; reviewing raw footage and identifying the strongest moments; developing pacing and storytelling within edits; adding appropriate on-screen text, subtitles, sound effects, music, screenshots, graphics, B-roll or visual elements; cleaning up audio; finding appropriate sounds or music; repurposing existing or older content; finding opportunities to turn one recording into multiple pieces of content; researching trends, creators, hooks and content formats; bringing new content concepts to me; organizing raw footage and completed content; helping maintain a content calendar; creating simple shot lists or recording requests for me; tracking content that needs to be recorded, edited, revised or published; helping prepare content for posting; and helping me build a more consistent content creation process. My current goal is approximately 3–5 quality pieces of content per week. I care much more about creating content that feels intentional, engaging and on-brand than posting filler just to say we posted something. // My Editing Style + Creative Direction // I don’t currently have one rigid or fully established editing style. Most of the content I create myself is relatively simple — clean cuts, occasional on-screen text or captions, music, sound effects and small visual details. But I would like my content to become more visually engaging, creative and recognizable over time. Part of why I’m hiring for this role is because I want someone who can help me develop that style with me. I already have a strong sense of what I like and, equally important, what I don’t like. I want someone with enough creative instinct to take those preferences, study my personality and brand, experiment with different approaches, and gradually help establish an editing style that feels distinctly like House of Agalliao and me. Eventually, I would love for there to be certain visual elements, editing choices or creative touches that people begin to recognize as part of my content — without making every video look exactly the same. I am not looking for someone who simply adds captions, random effects and transitions to every video and considers it finished. I like content that feels: Clean. Current. Personality-driven. Engaging. Intentional. Sometimes the strongest edit may be very simple. Other times a video might benefit from humor, sound effects, screenshots, B-roll, text, visual references, interesting cuts or other creative elements that strengthen the story. I want someone with enough creative judgment to understand the difference. I also don’t want an editor who applies the exact same editing template or style to every client. I want someone willing to experiment, learn what works for my audience, take feedback and help us develop our own visual identity over time. // Brand Voice // You’ll be working with content that represents both me personally and House of Agalliao, so understanding my personality will be important. My content tends to be conversational, confident, relatable, educational and sometimes funny. I don’t want my content to feel overly corporate, robotic, cheesy or obviously written by a social media assistant. You are not expected to understand my voice perfectly on day one. What matters more is whether you are observant enough to learn it. I want someone who pays attention to the way I naturally speak, the phrases I use, what I find funny, how I explain things and how I communicate with my audience — and gradually becomes better at helping me create content that still sounds and feels like me. Beauty + Hair Industry Understanding Previous experience in the hair industry is a plus, but it is not required. However, you must be interested and willing to learn. My content involves wig making, wig education, beauty entrepreneurship and the behind-the-scenes process of running and growing a beauty brand. You will encounter terminology surrounding things like closures, bundles, knots, glueless wigs, wig construction and other aspects of the hair industry. I don’t need someone pretending to already know everything. I would rather have someone curious enough to ask questions, learn the terminology and understand the audience than someone treating the content like generic beauty content. // Content Assistance // Editing is the primary part of this role, but I’m also looking for someone who can help make content creation feel less overwhelming for me. There may be weeks when I have a lot of footage ready to edit and weeks when I have less. During lighter editing periods, your work may shift toward researching content ideas, reviewing older footage for repurposing opportunities, organizing content, identifying trends or references, planning upcoming concepts, creating shot lists and helping determine what I should record next. I don’t want the entire content process to stop just because I haven’t handed you a new video yet. Part of the long-term goal is for this role to actually help me become a more consistent content creator. Eventually, I want us to reach a point where you might come to me and say: “Here are four ideas for next week. For this one, I just need you to record yourself doing this. For this one, answer this question on camera. And for this one, I can use footage we already have.” That level of initiative is something I would really value. // Schedule + Workload // This is an ongoing part-time position with a flexible workload. I currently expect the role to be somewhere around 10–15 hours per week, although workload may vary depending on how much content is being created. Some weeks may be more editing-heavy than others. I’m looking for someone who wants an ongoing working relationship rather than someone who only wants occasional one-off editing projects. There is also potential for the role, responsibilities and hours to grow over time as the brand grows. // Bonus Points // It’s a plus if you have previously edited content for beauty, hair, fashion, education, creator-led or personal brands. It’s also a plus if you understand basic content marketing, storytelling or consumer psychology; understand why someone might stop scrolling or continue watching a piece of content; know how to repurpose one recording into multiple pieces of content; have experience with tools such as CapCut, Canva and Google Drive; understand the difference between founder-led content and highly polished corporate content; or naturally come across something online and think: “We could do our version of this.” That kind of creative instinct is exactly what I’m interested in. // How to Apply // Please send me a short introduction telling me about yourself and why this specific role caught your attention. Please also include 3–5 examples of short-form videos you personally edited. Send me the work you think best represents your abilities rather than everything you’ve ever edited. If you have a portfolio, please include it. Tell me which editing software and tools you primarily use, your current availability, & your timezone. (Optional but recommended): I’d also like you to tell me one creator or brand whose social media content you think is really good right now — and why you think their content works. I’m interested in your answer because I want to understand your creative taste and the way you think about content, not just whether you technically know how to use editing software. Please do not send a generic copy-and-paste application. I’m much more interested in your creative taste, attention to detail, reliability, communication, initiative and ability to understand a brand than receiving the perfect résumé.

title: Advanced Video Editor

Social Media & Marketing Support -Edit videos optimized for platform performance, including YouTube, TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, and paid ads. -Create content that aligns with brand voice, target audience, and marketing goals. -Add clear calls-to-action when appropriate. -Help transform educational or informational content into engaging, shareable video assets. -Stay updated on video trends, editing styles, social media formats, and best practices. 4. Workflow & Collaboration -Work with the marketing team, content team, or business owner to understand video goals and creative direction. -Organize raw footage, project files, audio files, graphics, and final exports. -Follow brand guidelines for fonts, colors, logo usage, tone, and visual style. -Manage multiple video projects and meet deadlines consistently. -Accept feedback professionally and revise edits as needed. -Maintain clear communication about project status, timelines, and questions. Requirements Technical Skills -Advanced experience with professional video editing software such as: -Adobe Premiere Pro -Final Cut Pro -DaVinci Resolve -After Effects -CapCut or similar tools -Strong knowledge of video formats, codecs, frame rates, aspect ratios, and export settings. -Ability to edit both long-form and short-form content. -Experience with motion graphics, animated text, captions, transitions, and visual effects. -Strong audio editing skills, including noise reduction, volume balancing, music selection, and sound effects. -Understanding of color correction and color grading. -Ability to create platform-specific edits for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and paid ads. -Ability to work with raw footage, screen recordings, interviews, podcasts, webinars, and social media clips. Creative Skills -Strong sense of pacing, rhythm, storytelling, and visual composition. -Ability to create strong hooks in the first few seconds of a video. -Good judgment for choosing the best clips, visuals, music, and transitions. -Ability to make videos feel polished, engaging, and professional. -Understanding of how video editing impacts viewer retention and conversion. -Ability to follow brand style while also suggesting creative improvements. Professional Skills -Excellent attention to detail. -Strong communication skills. -Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. -Ability to manage deadlines and multiple projects. -Open to feedback and able to revise quickly. -Reliable, organized, and proactive. -Comfortable working remotely with digital project management tools. Preferred Qualifications -Experience editing videos for coaches, consultants, agencies, service businesses, personal brands, or online businesses. -Experience editing YouTube videos, YouTube Shorts, TikToks, Instagram Reels, and Facebook Reels. -Experience with direct-response video ads or conversion-focused social media content. -Experience using AI tools for video editing, transcription, captions, B-roll, thumbnails, or workflow automation. -Experience creating video thumbnails or working with designers on thumbnail concepts. -Basic understanding of social media marketing, audience retention, and content strategy.
