title: Per Project Wordpress Builder
description: We are hiring a **per-project WordPress + Elementor website builder** to work with our website production team. This position is ideal for someone who wants consistent project work, clear systems, and the ability to earn more as they prove they can handle projects independently. We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to drag Elementor widgets onto a page. We want someone who **thinks.** You should be able to follow instructions, pay attention to details, troubleshoot problems, communicate well, and use tools like ChatGPT and Claude intelligently. ### What We Provide Our production process is highly systemized. For standard website builds, **the website content will already be provided and mapped into the build.** You are not being paid these project rates to research and write an entire website from scratch. Your primary responsibility is taking the assets, content, instructions, and systems we provide and turning them into a polished finished website. ### What You'll Do Projects may include: * WordPress website builds * Elementor Pro * Responsive desktop/tablet/mobile implementation * Following approved designs or templates * Implementing mapped website content * Forms * Images and image optimization * Internal linking * Basic on-page SEO implementation * Rank Math * ACF/dynamic content when required * CSS adjustments * Website QC * Revisions * Troubleshooting issues * Following our build SOPs and documentation requirements We will train you on our specific production system. ### Compensation This is a **per-project position**, not a monthly salary. #### Probation Period During your initial probation/training period: **$90 per completed standard website** There is no bonus structure during probation. The purpose of this period is to learn our process, understand our expectations, and demonstrate that you can consistently complete projects correctly. Once you have proven yourself, you can advance into our normal production tiers. #### Tier 1 — Production Builder Standard 10-page website: **$70 base** Plus: * $10 First-Pass QC Bonus * $5 On-Time Completion Bonus * $5 Clean Handoff / Documentation Bonus **Up to $90 per standard 10-page website** #### Additional Pages Pages beyond the standard project are compensated based on complexity: **Basic / cloned page:** $3 per page **Enhanced page:** $4 per page Advanced custom pages, functionality, or unusual project requirements are priced separately before work begins. #### Tier 2 — Certified Builder **$100 per standard 10-page website** Tier 2 is earned through performance. Typically, we want to see at least 5 successful builds demonstrating: * Strong first-pass QC * Reliable on-time delivery * Good communication * No recurring quality issues * Understanding of our SOPs * Ability to troubleshoot independently #### Tier 3 — Advanced Builder Typically: **$125–$175+ per project** These builders can handle more complex projects, troubleshoot independently, require less management, and consistently produce high-quality work. Your earning potential increases as your value and capabilities increase. ### Who We're Looking For Experience matters, but **how you work matters more.** We would rather hire someone with 4 years of experience who is adaptable, hungry, and pays attention than someone with 10 years of experience who is stuck in their ways. You should: * Have solid Elementor Pro experience * Understand WordPress * Be comfortable using ChatGPT and/or Claude * Follow instructions carefully * Ask questions when something is genuinely unclear * Be capable of working independently * Communicate well with a team * Notice mistakes before QC notices them * Be willing to learn our processes * Accept constructive feedback * Take deadlines seriously * Think critically * Troubleshoot problems * Look for solutions instead of immediately saying something cannot be done We don't expect you to know our internal AI systems before joining. If you already understand how to effectively use ChatGPT or Claude, we can teach you our specific workflows. ### The Mentality We're Looking For When you encounter a problem, we don't want your first response to be: **"What do I do?"** We want you to first think: **"What is supposed to happen here? What information do I have? What can I test? Can I solve this safely myself? If I can't, what information does the team need from me to help solve it?"** There is nothing wrong with asking questions. In fact, asking good questions is extremely important. But there is a major difference between asking a thoughtful question after investigating a problem and requiring someone to think through every problem for you. ### How to Apply Please complete everything below. **Start your application with:** **"I READ THE ENTIRE POST."** Then answer: **1. Portfolio** Send 3 Elementor websites you personally worked on. Tell us specifically what YOU did on each website. **2. Experience** How long have you been working with WordPress and Elementor? What parts of a website build can you confidently complete independently? **3. AI** How do you currently use ChatGPT or Claude while building websites? Give us a real example. **4. Problem-Solving Scenario** Imagine you are assigned a website. The content has already been written and mapped. You are halfway through the build and notice three things: 1. One section does not fit the content very well. 2. The mobile version looks significantly worse than the desktop version. 3. A form is not submitting properly. The project manager will not be available for the next two hours. **Explain exactly what you would do.** Walk us through your thought process in order. Tell us: * What you investigate * What you try yourself * What you would change without approval * What you would NOT change without approval * What work you would continue completing * When you would escalate something * What you would send the project manager when asking for help There isn't one perfect answer. We want to see how you think. ### Growth We want builders who become more valuable over time. Someone who starts by following our SOPs but eventually becomes capable of independently troubleshooting difficult builds is worth considerably more to us. If you're competent, reliable, efficient, willing to learn, and interested in getting better instead of simply getting projects done, this could become a very strong long-term opportunity.

title: Outbound Caller & Lead Generation Specialist
description: READ THIS FIRST: The shift is 8:00 PM to 3:00 AM Manila time, Monday to Friday. That is 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM in Florida. This is a permanent night schedule. If that will not work for you long term, please do not apply. We would rather you keep your time. ABOUT US We are NH Repairs, a commercial and municipal fleet maintenance shop in Pompano Beach, Florida. We service and repair the vehicles that local businesses and city governments run on: the work trucks of contractors, plumbers, electricians and landscapers, plus heavy-duty tractors and trailers. We are small, we are growing, and we have big plans. We run lean. Every person here owns their work, and you will be working directly with the owner. We are hiring one person to make our outbound calls and generate our leads. That is the whole job, and right now it is the most important open seat in the company. This is a phone-first role. You will spend most of your shift on the phone: calling back the people who contacted us, calling the customers who were quoted work and never came back, and calling businesses in our target lists. Text and email back you up, they do not replace the call. WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO Follow-up calling, about 45% of your time. This is the heart of the job. Right now leads slip through the cracks. You will stop that. Call back every missed call the same day, and text as a backup when nobody picks up Call every new inquiry from our ads within 5 minutes, while they are still d ---------- who to call Work the deferred repair list: vehicles we already inspected, work we already quoted, jobs that were never scheduled Follow up on open estimates until you get a yes or a no Call back customers we have not seen in 6 months or more Call after every completed repair to check in and ask for a review Log every inbound call in our shared attribution tracker so we know which ads are producing real work and which ones are wasting money Lead generation, about 45% of your time. Half of your leads are already sitting in our system. The other half are local fleets we have not called yet. You will work both. Mine System for work that is already due: customers with preventive maintenance coming up, DOT inspections expiring, and units with open or deferred repairs. Call them and get the truck scheduled. Go through our existing customer list unit by unit and find out what each fleet has coming up Work our target lists of local businesses and fleets. We already have the lists. What we lack is the discipline to work them, and you will bring that. Find the right person at each company, the owner, the fleet manager, or whoever signs off on repairs, and start a real conversation Run supporting email and SMS campaigns to the same lists Keep calling until you get a yes or a no, and log every touch and every outcome Marketing support, about 10%. Help put together a newsletter twice a month, using AI tools heavily. We expect you to move fast with them. Help with website content and messaging Keep our message consistent across calls, email, text and social Report on what is working and what is not And whatever else the business needs. We are small and titles are loose here. If you see something broken and fix it, that gets noticed. SYSTEMS YOU WILL LIVE IN Fullbay, our shop management system. Every repair order, estimate, unit and customer history lives here, and it is where most of your leads will come from. You will learn it in your first two weeks. It is straightforward. Our phone and SMS platform, currently being upgraded. You will help us make it work. CRM, email marketing tools, Google Sheets, and AI writing tools You need to be genuinely comfortable with software. Not an engineer, but the kind of person who opens a new tool and figures it out without a manual, and who spots a better way to do something and says so. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR *Clear, confident spoken English. This is the most important requirement. You will be on the phone with American business owners, shop managers and municipal fleet staff every day, under our name. Neutral accent, easy to understand, comfortable holding a conversation that is not on a script. *Strong written English. Your texts and emails go straight to customers. Clear and natural, not stiff and not robotic. *Real outbound experience. You have called strangers and existing customers for a living and you are not nervous about it. *Background we especially want: dealership service BDC, appointment setting, outbound sales or SDR work on a US account, service scheduling, customer retention or reactivation, US collections, or contact center work with an outbound component. *Tech savvy. Comfortable in new software, spreadsheets, CRMs and AI tools. *Relentless follow-up. Most of this job is the third and fourth call. *Automotive, truck or fleet experience is a plus, not a requirement. We will teach you the vehicles. Reliable internet with a backup connection, backup power, a quiet workspace, and a good headset. On a night shift there is nobody to cover for you. NOT A FIT IF You cannot commit to a permanent night schedule You are looking for general admin or virtual assistant work You are uncomfortable on the phone, or you only want to do chat and email You measure your work in calls made rather than results You want a narrow job description that never changes HOW YOU WILL BE MEASURED On one thing: vehicles that come through our bay doors because you got them there. Not calls made, not messages sent, not appointments booked. Vehicles that arrive and get worked on. We will show you the number every week, and we pay you on it. COMPENSATION USD $4.50 to $5.50 per hour depending on experience. Performance commissions for vehicles that arrive because of your outreach begin after a 90-day trial period. Paid twice a month in USD via Wise, PayPal, or direct deposit. This is a long-term role, not a project. The right person grows with the shop, and we treat long-term contributors well. TO APPLY, INCLUDE 1.) A 2-minute voice or video recording in English. Tell us about a customer or prospect you got to say yes after they had already said no. What did you actually do? 2.) A short note on your last phone-heavy role and what number you were measured on. Give us the real figure. 3.) A writing sample. Write the actual text message you would send to a customer whose truck was inspected six weeks ago, who was quoted $1,800 in brake and suspension work, and who never scheduled it. Keep it under 60 words. 4.) Written confirmation that you can work 8:00 PM to 3:00 AM Manila time, Monday to Friday, long term. 5.) A description of your internet setup and your backup plan for power and connection. 6.) The word AIRBRAKE somewhere in your application. Applications without the voice recording and the writing sample will not be reviewed.

title: Sales Data Analyst
description: Sales Data Analyst Reports To: Chief Growth Officer Position Summary The Sales Data Analyst is responsible for collecting, analyzing, and interpreting sales and operational data to support strategic decision-making across the Growth Division. This role serves as a key business partner to the Chief Growth Officer by transforming complex data into actionable insights that improve sales performance, forecasting accuracy, referral growth strategies, and operational efficiency. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, detail-oriented, and proficient in Microsoft Excel and CRM reporting. They possess the ability to identify trends, build meaningful dashboards, and communicate data in a way that influences business decisions. This individual will also provide administrative and project support to the Chief Growth Officer as organizational priorities evolve. At least 8 hours must be between the hours of 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., US Central Standard Time. Applicant must provide their own technology equipment. ________________________________________ Essential Responsibilities Sales Analytics & Reporting • Analyze sales performance metrics across all markets. • Produce recurring daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual sales reports. • Track admissions, referrals, conversion rates, and other key performance indicators (KPIs). • Monitor performance against sales goals and identify trends requiring leadership attention. • Assist with forecasting future sales performance using historical and current data. • Prepare executive-level reports and presentations for leadership meetings. CRM Management & Data Integrity • Maintain reporting accuracy within the company's CRM platform. • Audit CRM data for completeness and accuracy. • Develop dashboards and scorecards for sales leadership. • Identify opportunities to improve CRM utilization and reporting efficiency. • Support sales leadership with CRM-related reporting and analytics. Referral Source & Market Analysis • Analyze referral source performance and trends. • Track referral growth and market share opportunities. • Identify referral sources showing increases or declines in volume. • Assist in territory analysis and account segmentation. • Provide data to support strategic sales planning and market expansion initiatives. Forecasting & Strategic Planning • Develop forecasting models using historical trends and current performance. • Assist the Chief Growth Officer with budgeting and growth projections. • Identify opportunities for revenue growth through data analysis. • Provide recommendations that improve sales effectiveness and resource allocation. Executive Support • Assist the Chief Growth Officer with special projects and strategic initiatives. • Prepare reports, presentations, and analytical summaries for executive meetings. • Conduct research as requested. • Coordinate and complete various administrative and analytical tasks supporting Growth operations. • Perform additional duties as assigned. ________________________________________ Qualifications Education Bachelor's degree in one of the following preferred: • Business • Finance • Data Analytics • Statistics • Healthcare Administration • Information Systems • Related field Equivalent work experience may be considered. ________________________________________ Experience Preferred: • 2–5 years of experience in data analysis, business analytics, sales operations, or healthcare analytics. • Experience supporting sales leadership. • Experience working with CRM systems. • Home Health or Healthcare experience is preferred but not required. ________________________________________ Required Skills • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills o Pivot Tables o Power Query o Advanced formulas o VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP o Data visualization • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills. • Ability to interpret large datasets and identify meaningful trends. • Excellent attention to detail. • Strong written and verbal communication skills. • Ability to present complex information in a simple, understandable format. • Strong organizational and time-management skills. • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. • High degree of confidentiality and professionalism. ________________________________________ Preferred Technical Skills Experience with: • CRM platforms • Microsoft Power BI (preferred) • Microsoft PowerPoint • Microsoft Word • Microsoft Teams • Microsoft SharePoint • SQL knowledge (preferred but not required) ________________________________________ Core Competencies • Analytical Thinking • Business Acumen • Strategic Planning • Problem Solving • Initiative • Collaboration • Communication • Adaptability • Organization • Data Accuracy • Confidentiality ________________________________________ Success Measures Success in this role will be measured by: • Accuracy and timeliness of reporting • Improvement in CRM data quality • Quality of forecasting and strategic recommendations • Ability to identify actionable sales opportunities through data • Executive satisfaction with reporting and analytical support • Efficiency in completing projects for the Chief Growth Officer • Contribution to achieving company growth objectives ________________________________________ Why Join Paradigm Home Health? At Paradigm Home Health, we believe data drives better decisions—and better decisions improve patient care. As our Sales Data Analyst, you'll play a critical role in shaping growth strategy by providing meaningful insights that help our leadership team make informed decisions. You'll work directly with the Chief Growth Officer, gain exposure to executive-level strategy, and have the opportunity to influence the future of one of Texas' fastest-growing clinician-owned home health organizations.

title: Full-Time Wordpress Web Builder
description: We are looking for a full-time Web Builder / VA to join our team long-term. This is not a position where we want someone who simply waits for a checklist, completes exactly what is written, and stops. We are looking for someone who can **think, problem-solve, pay attention, follow instructions, and take ownership of their work.** ### Starting Pay **$800 USD/month starting salary** We will begin with a **2-week paid trial for $400**. If the trial is successful, you will move into the ongoing full-time position at $800/month. There is absolutely room to grow beyond $800. The more valuable you become to the company, the more responsibility you can handle, and the more efficiently you can produce high-quality work, the more opportunity there will be for increased compensation. We would much rather pay more for someone who becomes incredibly valuable than constantly hire new people. ### What You'll Be Working On Our team builds and manages websites for businesses throughout the United States. You can expect to work on approximately **4–6 websites per month**, along with other website-related work. Our average website is approximately **30–40 pages**. Your work may include: * Building websites using WordPress + Elementor Pro * Following approved designs and design systems * Building desktop, tablet, and mobile layouts * Working with pre-written and mapped website content * Making website edits and revisions * Website QC * Sourcing and optimizing images * Setting up forms * Basic CSS adjustments * Working with ACF/dynamic content when required * Basic Rank Math/on-page SEO implementation * Internal linking * Blog formatting or occasional blog writing * Troubleshooting website problems * Using ChatGPT and Claude to help solve problems and work more efficiently You do **not** need to be an expert at every single item above on day one. We care much more about whether you can learn, follow our systems, and become more capable over time. ### What We're Looking For You should already be comfortable with: **WordPress** **Elementor Pro** **ChatGPT and/or Claude** **Responsive website design** More importantly, we're looking for someone who: * Pays extremely close attention to instructions * Notices when something doesn't look right * Asks good questions * Can work independently * Works well with a team * Can troubleshoot before immediately asking someone else to solve the problem * Uses AI as a tool instead of depending on AI to think for them * Is willing to learn new systems * Accepts feedback without becoming defensive * Takes responsibility for their work * Communicates when they are stuck * Thinks outside the box * Looks for solutions * Wants to continually become better at their job **Years of experience are not the d ---------- factor.** Someone with 4 years of experience who is hungry, adaptable, and constantly learning is more valuable to us than someone with 10 years of experience who believes they already know everything. ### Schedule This is a **full-time position**. We are flexible regarding which days you choose to work. However, once your work schedule is agreed upon, we expect you to stick to it. We care about accountability, communication, meeting deadlines, and producing quality work. ### How We Work You will receive training on our specific processes. We use SOPs, AI-assisted workflows, project management systems, website templates, design systems, and internal processes to make our work as repeatable as possible. We do not expect you to magically know our system. We **do** expect you to learn it. We also don't want someone who needs step-by-step instructions every time something unexpected happens. Our ideal team member thinks: **"What is the outcome we're trying to accomplish, what information do I already have, and what can I try before escalating this?"** Knowing when to ask a question is just as important as knowing how to solve something yourself. ### Application Instructions Please answer ALL of the following. Applications that ignore the instructions may not be considered. **1. Portfolio** Send us links to 3 websites you personally worked on. For each one, briefly explain exactly what YOU were responsible for. **2. Elementor Experience** How comfortable are you with Elementor Pro from 1–10? Tell us what you can confidently do without needing instructions. **3. AI Experience** How are you currently using ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI tools in your work? Give us one real example. **4. Problem-Solving Scenario** Imagine this situation: You are building a 35-page website in Elementor. The design and content have already been provided. You reach one page where the provided content does not fit the approved section design very well. You also notice that the mobile version of the section looks bad. The project manager is currently unavailable. **Walk us through exactly what you would do next.** We are less interested in the "correct answer" than we are in understanding how you think. Explain: * What you would check first * What you would attempt yourself * Whether you would continue working or stop * At what point you would ask the team for help * What information you would include when asking for help **5. Attention to Detail** At the very beginning of your application, write: **"I READ THE ENTIRE POST."** This is intentionally simple. ### One Last Thing We are building a team of people who want to become exceptionally good at what they do. You don't need to know everything. You do need to care. If you are someone who learns quickly, takes ownership, enjoys solving problems, and wants an opportunity where becoming more valuable creates more opportunity for you, we'd like to hear from you.

job_title: Virtual Assistant in Customer Service, Social Media, and Sales
description: Premier Oaks Landscape is a full-service landscaping company providing mowing, landscaping, and irrigation repair services. We’re looking for someone who has at least 5 years of professional experience, communicates clearly in English, and is comfortable speaking with US customers over the phone. Key Responsibilities 1. Administrative Support – Manage emails, calendars, data entry, and daily administrative tasks. 2. Customer Service – Respond to customer questions and provide timely, professional support. Phone Sales – Handle sales calls, follow up with leads, answer questions, and help book new customers. 3. CRM Management – Keep customer information, lead status, notes, and follow-ups updated in Jobber. 4. Social Media Management – Assist with posting, engagement, and managing social media content. description: We are looking for a talented Illustrator / Graphic Designer to create original artwork for an established e-commerce clothing brand. This is NOT a position for creating ads, social media graphics, website banners, or marketing materials. Your job will be focused on one thing: creating original artwork and designs that will be printed on clothing. What We're Looking For We want someone who is genuinely talented at illustration and design. Our brand is heavily inspired by Japanese culture and aesthetics, but our designs can vary significantly in style. You should be comfortable adapting to different visual directions rather than being limited to one specific illustration style. We care much more about the quality of your work and portfolio than how many years of experience you have. Experience creating artwork for apparel, streetwear, or clothing brands is preferred, but not required. Your Responsibilities Your main responsibility will be creating original artwork for our clothing designs. We will provide concepts, references, ideas, and creative direction for many designs. For some projects, you may also be given more freedom to interpret an idea in your own way. You should be able to: * Create original illustrations from scratch * Work from references and creative direction * Adapt to different illustration and graphic styles * Combine illustration, composition, and typography when a design requires it * Make revisions based on feedback * Deliver at least 4–5+ quality designs per week * Prepare artwork suitable for printing on apparel Knowledge of designing for DTG printing and preparing print-ready artwork is a plus. What We Care About We're not looking for someone who can simply use graphic design software. We're looking for someone who has a strong artistic eye and actual illustration/design ability. You should understand composition, typography, color, balance, and what makes artwork visually appealing on a T-shirt or other piece of clothing. Most importantly, you should be able to create original artwork, not simply combine templates or stock graphics. At the very beginning of your application, write the word SAKURA so we know you read the entire job post. AI tools may be used as part of your creative process when appropriate, but you must have the ability to create and modify artwork yourself. We are not looking for someone who simply generates AI images and submits them as finished designs. Work Arrangement We are open to both full-time and part-time applicants. You can work on your own schedule. We care primarily about communication, reliability, meeting deadlines, and the quality of the designs you deliver. There is also opportunity for performance-based bonuses and pay increases for consistently strong work. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a paid design test before being hired. How to Apply Please answer ALL of the following questions in your application: 1. Tell us about your experience as an illustrator or graphic designer. 2. Have you created designs for clothing, apparel, or streetwear brands before? If yes, please explain what you worked on. 3. What software do you use to create your illustrations and designs? 4. Which illustration/design styles are you strongest at? 5. Are you comfortable creating Japanese-inspired artwork in different styles? 6. Are you able to create original illustrations from scratch? 7. Do you have experience preparing artwork for DTG printing or other apparel printing methods? 8. Do you use AI tools as part of your design process? If yes, explain exactly how you use them. 9. How many high-quality apparel designs do you believe you can realistically complete per week? 10. Are you currently working for another company or client? If yes, approximately how many hours per week? 11. Are you looking for full-time or part-time work? 12. Please provide a link to your portfolio. Your portfolio is the most important part of your application. Please send examples that demonstrate your actual illustration and artwork abilities. We are especially interested in apparel graphics, illustrations, streetwear designs, Japanese-inspired artwork, or similar work. If your portfolio mostly consists of advertisements, social media posts, website banners, Canva designs, or other marketing graphics, this position is probably not the right fit. Applications without a portfolio or without answers to the questions above will not be considered. We're looking for someone we can work with long-term who can consistently create strong, original artwork for our brand.

title: Executive Virtual Assistant — CRO Support (Financial Services)
job_title: Executive Virtual Assistant — CRO Support (Financial Services)
description: Role: The Executive Virtual Assistant is the operational backbone of a fast-growing financial advisory firm. You'll work directly with the Chief Revenue Officer to eliminate bottlenecks, execute processes, and keep systems running so leadership can focus on strategy instead of admin. This isn't a "check your email and schedule meetings" VA role. You'll be inside HubSpot pulling reports and executing outreach, posting social media replies through Sprout Social, coordinating contractors, running SMS broadcasts, and keeping our project management system clean and current. You'll follow SOPs we've already built, but you'll also be expected to flag when something is broken and suggest a better way. Here's what you'll actually do: - Post AI-generated social media replies across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and X through Sprout Social — reviewing each for quality before publishing - Manage SMS broadcast campaigns — pulling lists from HubSpot, scheduling sends, and monitoring delivery - Pull and compile reports from HubSpot — surfacing key metrics, pipeline snapshots, and deal activity summaries so leadership doesn't have to dig for information - Keep our project management system (Asana) organized — chasing tea ---------- mbers for status updates, archiving dead projects, and ensuring dashboards reflect reality - Handle webinar logistics — registration list management, reminder sequences, post-event follow-up segmentation, and replay distribution - Coordinate marketing contractors — collecting deliverables, tracking deadlines, routing approvals, and following up so nothing falls through the cracks To win in this role, you need to be detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable working across multiple platforms simultaneously. You should be someone who takes ownership of processes — not someone who waits to be told what to do next. ## Why This Role Matters (for You): If you want to learn how a high-growth US financial services company actually operates — from sales pipelines to marketing automation to client experience — this role gives you a front-row seat. You'll work directly with leadership, not through layers of middle management. You'll touch every part of the business: sales ops, marketing, content, client experience, and technology. That breadth of exposure is rare and will make you significantly more valuable in any future role. We invest in training. We have documented SOPs, video walkthroughs, and AI tools that do the heavy thinking — your job is reliable execution and continuous improvement. We don't micromanage, but we do expect ownership. If you thrive in structured environments where the playbook exists and you just need to run it well — you'll love this. If you need someone standing over your shoulder to stay productive, this isn't the right fit. ## Responsibilities - Execute social media engagement workflows daily — reviewing AI-generated replies for tone and accuracy, then publishing through Sprout Social across all platforms - Manage and send SMS marketing broadcasts using our SMS platform, including list preparation and scheduling - Own the YouTube production coordination workflow — tracking recurring tasks, managing approvals, and ensuring content ships on schedule - Compile weekly CRM reports — pulling pipeline snapshots, deal velocity metrics, and activity summaries from HubSpot so leadership has what they need without digging for it - Maintain project management hygiene in Asana — collecting status updates, archiving completed or abandoned projects, and keeping dashboards accurate - Coordinate webinar operations end-to-end — from registration list pulls through post-event follow-up sequences - Serve as the communication layer between leadership and marketing contractors — tracking deliverables, deadlines, and approvals - Document and improve processes — when you find a better way to do something, write it down so it scales ## Results - Social media replies posted within 24 hours of comment, with zero off-brand or inaccurate responses published - Weekly CRM reports delivered on time — leadership has pipeline and activity visibility without asking for it - Asana dashboards reflect actual project status — every active project has a current status update - Webinar logistics executed without missed steps — registrations captured, reminders sent, follow-ups segmented - Contractor deliverables tracked and delivered on time — nothing falls through the cracks between request and completion ## Requirements - 3+ years of experience as a Virtual Assistant, Executive Assistant, or Operations Coordinator supporting US-based businesses - Strong working knowledge of HubSpot CRM (deal management, contact properties, list building, task management) - Experience with social media management tools (Sprout Social preferred, but Hootsuite, Buffer, or similar accepted) - Proficiency in project management tools (Asana, Monday, ClickUp, or similar) - Excellent written English — you'll be reviewing client-facing social media content in a regulated industry - Highly organized with strong attention to detail — financial services has zero tolerance for sloppy mistakes - Self-motivated and proactive — you flag problems before they become emergencies - Comfortable learning new tools quickly — we use HubSpot, Sprout Social, Asana, Slack, SalesMessage, Google Workspace, and several other platforms - Reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace for occasional video calls ## Nice to Have (Not Required) - Experience in financial services, wealth management, or insurance industries - Familiarity with SMS marketing platforms (SalesMessage, ClickSend, or similar) - Experience with webinar platforms (EverWebinar, Zoom Webinars, or similar) - Basic understanding of sales pipelines and CRM workflows - Experience coordinating with contractors or freelancers ## Schedule & Compensation - **Hours:** Full-time (40 hours/week) - **Schedule:** Flexible, with 3-4 hours of overlap required during US Mountain Time business hours (9 AM – 5 PM MT) for real-time communication and approvals - **Rate:** $7–$10/hour USD, depending on experience - **Type:** Long-term, ongoing position — this is not a project-based role ## About Us Q3 Advisors is a flat-fee fiduciary financial advisory firm specializing in Roth conversion strategies. We've grown from $1.9M to $15M+ in revenue in three years with a lean, high-performance team. We move fast, we build systems, and we take care of our people. You'll be joining a team that includes sales reps, financial planners, marketing specialists, and operations staff — all working together to help retirees keep more of their money. The work matters, the team is sharp, and the company is growing.

job_title: Experienced Faceless YouTube Producer — Science / What-If Videos
description: EXPERIENCED CREATORS ONLY — NO BEGINNERS OR TRAINING PROVIDED. Please apply only if you have personally produced complete long-form faceless YouTube videos, including research, scriptwriting, voiceover production, visual creation/sourcing, and editing. Applications without relevant, full-length video examples will not be considered. Short-form-only portfolios, showreels, and experience limited to editing supplied scripts and voiceovers are not sufficient for this role. ABOUT THE ROLE I’m building an English-language science and curiosity channel inspired by the “What If” format: compelling hypothetical questions explored through engaging storytelling, clear explanations, and strong visuals. Topics may include space, Earth, technology, animals, and surprising scientific scenarios. I’m looking for one experienced, independent producer who can take a topic from initial concept to a polished, upload-ready video. This is an ongoing part-time role, not an entry-level VA position. You must already have a reliable production workflow. I will approve topics, agree on the visual style, and review finished videos. I will not provide scripts, footage folders, prompts, editing tutorials, or daily supervision. MONTHLY DELIVERABLES Four complete production packages per month, delivered on an agreed schedule approximately once a week. Each package includes: • One original 8–12-minute YouTube video, 16:9, minimum 1080p. • One 45–60-second vertical promotional Short, 9:16, with captions. • Two strong thumbnail options. • Three title options and one finished description. • A source list supporting the key factual claims. The Short should work as an engaging standalone teaser that creates interest in the full video—not simply the first minute cropped vertically. An occasional fifth monthly package will require a separate agreement and additional payment. YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Propose three promising topics for each upcoming video, with a potential title, a short explanation of the hook, and why viewers would care. 2. After topic approval, independently research and write an original script. Clearly distinguish established facts, assumptions, and speculation. Verify important claims against reliable sources; AI output is not a source. 3. Produce natural-sounding English voiceover. AI narration is welcome, but you must correct pronunciation, awkward delivery, and pacing. 4. Create and source relevant visuals: AI illustrations, stock footage, diagrams, maps, on-screen explanations, and appropriate animation. 5. Edit the complete video with strong opening seconds, clear storytelling, purposeful pacing, music, and sound design. 6. Create packaging that earns attention honestly. Titles and thumbnails should create curiosity without inventing events or promising something the video does not deliver. 7. Quality-check everything before delivery. I should be reviewing a finished product, not finding obvious mistakes or teaching the production process. QUALITY EXPECTATIONS • Strong written English and a genuine interest in science and curiosity-driven storytelling. • A compelling hook and a coherent progression toward a satisfying answer. • Visuals that explain and support the narration. • Consistent visual style and clean audio. • No generic AI slideshows, copied scripts, recycled compilations, or random footage used to fill time. • Properly sourced assets suitable for commercial use. • Reliable delivery without repeated reminders. • Ability to handle a consolidated revision round independently. We take inspiration from successful formats, but create our own scripts, visuals, and channel identity. COMPENSATION AND WORKING ARRANGEMENT • $600 USD per month for four complete production packages. • Approved production tools paid separately by me, with an initial budget of up to $100/month. • Approximately 20 hours per week, with a flexible schedule. • One consolidated revision round per package is included. Factual, technical, or agreed-specification errors must be corrected before final delivery. • No required daily meetings. You may propose your existing toolset. You do not need to use a specific editing application, but you must already know how to produce this type of content within the agreed budget. HIRING PROCESS Shortlisted candidates will be offered one paid pilot package at $150, with scope and payment terms agreed before work begins. No unpaid custom video is required to apply. We will agree on the initial visual direction before you produce the pilot. Ongoing work depends on the quality of the finished package, your independence, and reliable delivery—not promises of guaranteed views. HOW TO APPLY Start your application with: WHAT IF — FULL-CYCLE PRODUCER Please include: 1. Links to 2–3 published, full-length faceless videos you personally worked on. At least one must demonstrate full-cycle production. State exactly which parts you handled and what, if anything, the client supplied. 2. Identify the example closest to what you could realistically deliver at this budget and explain why. 3. One science/what-if topic you would propose for this channel, with a potential title and a brief explanation of the opening hook. No full script is required. 4. Your production tools and any subscriptions we would need to provide. 5. Your estimated turnaround time, weekly availability, and confirmation that you can deliver four complete packages per month for $600. 6. If available, share performance or retention results for your work, explaining your contribution. Do not share confidential client information. Please answer these points directly rather than sending a generic cover letter. If you need training, supplied scripts, or ongoing step-by-step direction, this role is not a fit.

The goal is simple: Help our clients get found more often, generate more website traffic, receive more phone calls and leads, and increase their visibility across Google Search, Google Maps, and AI-powered search platforms. We want someone who understands how businesses can improve their chances of appearing or being referenced within platforms and experiences such as: Google AI Overviews ChatGPT Gemini Perplexity Claude Bing / Copilot Other AI-powered search engines This includes understanding topics such as entity authority, structured data, topical authority, citations, trusted third-party mentions, content structure, brand signals, reviews, and creating content that search engines and AI systems can easily understand. What You Will Be Responsible For You will help manage SEO fulfillment across multiple client accounts. Your responsibilities may include: SEO Strategy Review each client's website, competitors, rankings, Google Business Profile, Search Console data, keywords, backlinks, and local market. Determine: What is preventing the client from ranking Which keywords represent the greatest opportunities Which pages need to be created Which pages need to be improved What technical problems need to be fixed What competitors are doing better What needs to happen over the next 30, 60, and 90 days We do not want someone waiting for us to tell them every SEO task to complete. We want someone capable of helping determine what the tasks should be. On-Page SEO Optimize: Title tags Meta descriptions H1/H2/H3 structure Page copy Keyword placement Search intent Internal linking Image optimization Alt text URL structure Schema Calls-to-action Service pages City/location pages Pages should be optimized for rankings without sacrificing readability or conversions. Local SEO Develop strategies to increase client visibility within their target markets. This includes: Google Business Profile optimization Local keyword research Local competitor analysis Google Maps optimization Citation management NAP consistency Review strategies Local backlinks Service-area optimization City/location landing pages Local schema Local authority building Content Strategy Help determine what content should be created based on actual SEO opportunities. We don't want articles written simply because we need to publish another blog. Content should have a purpose. Examples include: Building topical authority Supporting service pages Capturing long-tail searches Answering customer questions Supporting internal linking Improving local relevance Increasing visibility in AI search Building authority around our clients' services Technical SEO Identify and help resolve problems including: Indexing problems Crawlability Broken links 404 errors Redirects Duplicate content Canonical issues Sitemap problems Robots.txt issues Page speed Core Web Vitals Mobile usability Schema errors Website architecture Reporting & Performance SEO work must connect to business results. We care about: Organic clicks Organic impressions Keyword movement Local Map Pack rankings Google Business Profile visibility Website traffic Phone calls Form submissions Leads Conversion rates New ranking keywords Top 3 / Top 10 rankings Overall local search visibility Rankings are important, but rankings without leads or customers aren't enough. Tools Experience with several of the following is preferred: Google Search Console Google Analytics 4 Google Business Profile Google Tag Manager Ahrefs SEMrush Ubersuggest Screaming Frog BrightLocal Local Falcon PageSpeed Insights Google Keyword Planner WordPress GoHighLevel Duda Schema / structured-data tools AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Perplexity You do not need to know every tool listed. Understanding SEO strategy is more important than knowing how to click buttons inside an SEO platform. What We Do NOT Want We are not looking for someone who: Buys thousands of spam backlinks Uses outdated SEO tactics Keyword-stuffs webpages Publishes hundreds of low-quality AI articles Creates reports without taking action Completes tasks without understanding why they are being done Needs detailed instructions for every SEO decision Guarantees #1 Google rankings Focuses only on rankings while ignoring conversions Uses the exact same SEO strategy for every client Who We're Looking For The ideal person is analytical, curious, organized, and slightly obsessed with figuring out why one business ranks above another. You should be comfortable looking at a website you've never seen before and investigating: Why aren't they ranking? Then developing and executing a strategy to change that. We actually want someone who may know more about SEO than we do. We don't need another person to simply follow an SEO checklist. We want someone who can eventually become a trusted SEO expert within our agency. Experience Ideally, you have: 3+ years of hands-on SEO experience Experience ranking local businesses in the United States Experience managing multiple SEO accounts Case studies or examples of ranking improvements Experience with Google Business Profiles Strong written English Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities Agency experience is highly preferred. When Applying Please answer the following questions. 1. Tell us about one local business you helped rank. What was the industry? What market were they targeting? What was the problem when you started? What exactly did you change? What happened to rankings, traffic, calls, or leads? 2. A plumber is ranking #14 in Google Maps for "plumber Asheville NC." Walk us through what you would investigate first. 3. What are the three most important factors you currently look at when trying to improve Google Maps rankings? 4. How would you determine whether a website needs more content, better existing content, backlinks, or technical improvements? 5. What is your current understanding of optimizing businesses for Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity? 6. What SEO tools do you currently use? 7. Please provide examples, screenshots, case studies, or websites where you personally performed the SEO work. Do not send generic SEO reports. We want to understand what you personally did and why you did it. The Opportunity We are looking for someone interested in working with us long term. As our client base grows, this position has the opportunity to grow into a larger SEO fulfillment / SEO leadership role within the agency. If you understand SEO beyond completing tasks and enjoy figuring out how to make businesses dominate their local markets, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Account Manager
description: Position Summary The Account Manager is the primary relationship owner for an assigned portfolio of clients. This role protects and grows recurring revenue by understanding each client’s business objectives, ensuring dependable service delivery, resolving issues with urgency, and identifying practical opportunities to expand Barrister’s value. The Account Manager serves as a trusted advisor and internal quarterback, aligning sales, operations, service delivery, finance, and subject-matter experts around measurable client outcomes. Essential Responsibilities Client Relationship Ownership & Retention -Own day-to-day and strategic relationships for assigned accounts, serving as a responsive, dependable point of contact for client stakeholders. -Build and maintain multi-level relationships with executive sponsors, decision makers, procurement, IT/operations leaders, and end users; create and maintain current relationship maps. -Develop a thorough understanding of each client’s business model, priorities, operating environment, contractual commitments, and definition of success. -Conduct regular account touchpoints and formal Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to review performance, risks, business priorities, realized value, and upcoming opportunities. -Measure and improve client health, satisfaction, retention, and advocacy; actively gather feedback and turn it into clear actions and follow-up communication. -Anticipate concerns, identify churn or service risks early, and lead timely recovery plans through resolution and client confirmation. Account Strategy, Revenue Growth & Commercial Management -Create, maintain, and execute an account business plan for each assigned client, including revenue and margin goals, renewal milestones, growth targets, relationship strategy, risk mitigation, and action owners. -Identify whitespace and customer needs that can be addressed through appropriate services, solutions, upgrades, renewals, cross-sell, or upsell opportunities. -Lead consultative discovery and value-based conversations; translate client requirements into practical recommendations, proposals, and measurable business cases. -Partner with Sales Executives and technical or operational teams to qualify opportunities, develop solutions, prepare pricing and proposals, negotiate within authority, and close business. -Protect profitability by considering scope, delivery feasibility, service levels, costs, pricing, and contract commitments before making or presenting commitments. -Drive contract renewal planning well in advance of expiration, including commercial strategy, client alignment, required approvals, and complete CRM documentation. Service Delivery, Escalation & Internal Leadership -Coordinate cross-functional resources to ensure products and services are delivered on time, within scope and budget, and in accordance with service-level agreements (SLAs). -Act as the client advocate internally while balancing client needs with company commitments, operational realities, compliance obligations, and financial goals. -Lead escalations from initial triage through documented corrective action, regular status communication, root-cause review when appropriate, and confirmed closure. -Monitor service performance, deliverables, invoicing, scheduling, and key dependencies; promptly escalate material delivery, cost, quality, or compliance risks. -Participate in client kickoffs, implementation transitions, and service reviews to establish clear expectations, ownership, communication cadence, and success measures. -Develop and communicate account-level project plans for material client initiatives, clearly defining milestones, owners, dependencies, risks, and completion criteria. -Standardize and refine delivery processes across the portfolio so strategic clients receive a consistent, high-quality experience. -Support continuous improvement by identifying recurring issues, process gaps, training needs, and scalable improvements across accounts. Financial, Data & Pipeline Discipline -Manage to assigned revenue, retention, margin, renewal, expansion, and customer-experience targets. -Maintain accurate, timely CRM records for contacts, opportunities, account plans, activities, renewal dates, forecasts, risks, and next steps. -Review account health and financial performance, including volume trends, utilization, margin, expenses, invoicing, and SLA compliance; flag variances and potential overruns immediately. -Provide clear weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting and forecasts, including pipeline, renewal outlook, wins, risks, recovery actions, and required leadership support. -Use client data, industry insight, and internal performance information to prioritize initiatives, substantiate recommendations, and quantify value or return on investment. Client Enablement & Business Improvement -Provide or coordinate client-specific education, enablement, and supporting materials that improve adoption, service outcomes, and growth of the company’s offerings. -Identify and implement service-delivery and account-management improvements that reduce avoidable cost, improve efficiency, and protect the client experience. -Use formal customer evaluations and feedback channels to validate satisfaction, recognize performance gaps, and drive continuous improvement. -Maintain appropriate confidentiality and discretion when handling client, commercial, operational, or financial information. Qualifications Required -Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience. -3+ years of client-facing account management, customer success, sales, service management, project management, or related experience; experience managing complex B2B accounts preferred. -Demonstrated ability to build trusted client relationships, retain business, solve problems, and manage several priorities with sound judgment. -Strong written, verbal, presentation, organizational, analytical, and interpersonal communication skills. -Ability to work effectively across a matrixed organization and influence internal and external stakeholders at multiple levels. -Proficiency with CRM systems (Salesforce preferred) and Microsoft Office, including Excel and PowerPoint. Preferred -Experience meeting revenue, renewal, growth, margin, or customer-satisfaction goals within a technology, managed services, IT lifecycle, telecommunications, logistics, or other complex service environment. -Experience delivering QBRs, account business plans, complex proposals, renewals, and contract negotiations. -Experience coordinating service delivery, technical, logistics, finance, or operational teams for complex client programs. -Working knowledge of the company’s relevant solutions, delivery model, competitive landscape, and client industry. Core Competencies -Client-centered and consultative: listens carefully, earns credibility, connects solutions to business outcomes, and communicates honestly. -Commercially accountable: balances client value with revenue, margin, scope, and long-term account health. -Proactive and organized: anticipates needs, follows through, manages deadlines, and maintains complete documentation. -Analytical and solutions-oriented: uses data to recognize patterns, diagnose issues, prioritize actions, and improve results. -Collaborative and resilient: coordinates diverse teams, handles difficult conversations professionally, and remains calm under pressure. -Ethical and dependable: protects confidential information, honors commitments, follows policies, and exercises sound judgment. Performance Measures -Specific targets will be established by leadership based on portfolio type, account maturity, and company priorities. Typical measures include: -Revenue retention, renewal rate, expansion revenue, quota attainment, and year-over-year growth. -Portfolio margin, pricing discipline, forecast accuracy, invoice timeliness, and control of avoidable costs or overruns. -Client satisfaction, Net Promoter Score (NPS) or equivalent feedback, churn, issue-response time, and escalation resolution. -SLA performance, implementation/service quality, account-plan completion, QBR completion, CRM data quality, and pipeline coverage. -Quality of executive relationships, client engagement, teamwork, and demonstrated contribution to scalable process improvements. Work Environment & Additional Information This position may require occasional travel to client locations, industry events, or internal meetings, depending on portfolio needs. The duties and responsibilities above are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed and are not an exhaustive list. Management may assign additional duties consistent with the role and business needs.

title: Virtual Assistant - Travel Concierge
description: We're looking for a **Travel Concierge** who is passionate about crafting seamless travel experiences and delivering high-quality client service. You will be the trusted expert behind every journey, using AI-powered tools to research and recommend hotels, coordinating logistics across platforms, and communicating directly with travelers via WhatsApp to make every trip feel effortless and personal. This role is for someone who loves travel, writes with warmth and clarity, thinks fast when plans change, and takes pride in the kind of attention to detail that makes clients feel like VIPs from the first message through check-in. ## Why You'll Want to Join - You will be paid in **USD** (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th) - **Paid Time Off** in accordance with company policy - Observance of **Holidays** per company guidelines - **100% remote setup** so you can work wherever you're most productive - This role requires availability during **US Eastern Time business hours** - Work in the luxury travel and hospitality space with access to premium brands and destinations - Use cutting-edge AI tools to enhance research and elevate the client experience ## What You'll Work On **Client Engagement and Support** - Chat with travelers via WhatsApp to understand their preferences and deliver personalized recommendations - Respond quickly and thoughtfully to incoming inquiries with initial responses landing within 10 to 20 minutes during your shift - Handle special requests and ensure smooth communication between clients and hotels or vendors - Maintain a calm, professional, and reassuring tone even when plans change at the last minute **Research and Booking** - Research and recommend hotels, restaurants, and attractions using AI tools and reliable online sources - Verify every detail including location, timing, currency, and amenities before confirming bookings - Coordinate hotel reservations, car rentals, and travel logistics across multiple booking platforms **Content and Destination Curation** - Write and curate destination guides and travel recommendations that blend editorial polish with practical, on-the-ground insight - Collaborate with the marketing team to highlight exceptional hotels and destinations for social content - Stay current on travel trends, new openings, and hidden gems worth knowing about **Problem-Solving and Adaptability** - Think fast and find creative solutions when plans shift due to flight delays, cancellations, or unexpected changes - Communicate clearly and calmly under pressure to maintain client confidence and satisfaction ## What You Bring - Empathetic and client-obsessed: you treat every traveler like a VIP - Detail-oriented and reliable: you catch mistakes others miss before they become problems - Exceptional written English: you write with clarity, warmth, and professionalism - A self-starter: you love learning, exploring, and improving processes without being asked - Tech-savvy: comfortable using Slack, WhatsApp, Google Sheets and Docs, and booking platforms - Fast but thoughtful: you balance responsiveness with high-quality work - Curious and well-informed: you research effectively, verify information, and stay ahead of travel trends ## Nice to Have - Background in hospitality, travel, or concierge services - Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT or travel research assistants - Familiarity with airlines, loyalty programs, and travel booking systems - International travel experience or strong knowledge of major global destinations - Negotiation skills to advocate for clients with vendors and hotels ## How to Apply Please include: 1. Your **updated resume** highlighting any customer service or travel-related experience 2. A **short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes)** introducing yourself and sharing why you are passionate about travel and client service **Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.** If you love connecting with people, solving travel challenges, and creating experiences that feel effortless for the traveler, this role gives you the platform and the tools to do that every single day.

title: Full-Time Sales + Admin Virtual Assistant for Canadian Home Service Company
job_title: Full-Time Sales + Admin Virtual Assistant for Canadian Home Service Company
description: # FULL-TIME INBOUND SALES + ADMIN VA ## Canadian Home Service Company **PLEASE READ THE ENTIRE POST BEFORE APPLYING.** We are hiring a full-time Virtual Assistant to handle **INBOUND SALES, lead follow-up, booking, and basic administration** for a growing home service company in Alberta, Canada. ### THIS IS PRIMARILY A PHONE SALES POSITION. You will be speaking with Canadian homeowners every day. **Excellent SPOKEN English is absolutely required.** Being able to write English well is not enough. You need to sound natural, confident, conversational, and comfortable speaking with customers on the phone. If you are uncomfortable selling over the phone, this is not the right position. --- # WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING We generate inbound leads through Facebook and Instagram advertising. These are people who have already filled out a form asking about our services. **This is NOT primarily cold calling.** When a new lead comes in, you will: 1. Call them quickly 2. Understand what service they are interested in 3. Explain our service clearly 4. Look at their property online 5. Provide a quote using our pricing system 6. Ask for the booking 7. Schedule the job 8. Follow up if they don't book immediately 9. Keep the CRM and lead information organized Our main services are: * Window Cleaning * House Washing / Soft Washing We will provide training, sales scripts, service information, pricing guidelines, and follow-up procedures. You do not need to already understand window cleaning or soft washing. **You DO need to be capable of learning the information and explaining it confidently to customers.** --- # SPOKEN ENGLISH IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT Please understand this before applying. You will spend a large portion of your day **talking to Canadian homeowners on the phone.** We are looking for someone who: * Speaks fluent English * Is very easy for North American customers to understand * Sounds natural rather than scripted * Can hold a normal conversation * Sounds confident and energetic * Can take control of a sales conversation * Can explain services clearly * Is comfortable asking customers to book * Can handle basic objections without freezing * Is friendly without sounding like a call-centre robot Sales experience is strongly preferred. Experience with inbound sales, appointment setting, customer service, home services, or phone-based sales is a major advantage. --- # WORK SCHEDULE This is a **FULL-TIME POSITION.** **Monday through Saturday** **8 hours per day** You must be able to consistently work during our required Alberta, Canada hours. This position requires a serious commitment to the schedule. Do not apply if you already have another full-time job that will interfere with these hours. --- # SALES RESPONSIBILITIES Your primary responsibility is converting inbound leads into booked jobs. You will: * Respond to new leads quickly * Call inbound Facebook/Instagram leads * Text customers * Follow our sales process * Explain window cleaning and house washing * Provide quotes using our pricing system * Look up customer properties using Google Maps * Ask for the sale * Book jobs * Follow up with leads who don't answer * Follow up with customers who were quoted but did not book * Reactivate older leads when instructed * Keep detailed notes on conversations You will be measured on performance. Important numbers include: * New leads * Conversations * Follow-up attempts * Quotes given * Jobs booked * Revenue booked * Close rate * Average ticket --- # ADMIN RESPONSIBILITIES When you are not actively handling leads, you will also help with basic administration. This may include: * Updating Housecall Pro * Scheduling and rescheduling customers * Updating customer information * Keeping lead records organized * Sending estimates * Sending invoices * Appointment confirmations * Customer texts * Basic email communication * Following up on unpaid invoices * Review requests * Keeping notes organized * Helping make sure customers and leads do not fall through the cracks Sales always comes first when a new lead comes in. --- # WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR The ideal person is: * Fluent in spoken English * Confident on the phone * Persuasive without being pushy * Competitive * Energetic * Reliable * Organized * Fast learner * Comfortable using computers and CRM software * Comfortable being coached on sales calls * Able to follow systems and scripts without sounding scripted * Able to work independently * Interested in a long-term position We want someone who actually wants to become **very good at selling**, not someone looking to quietly complete administrative tasks for eight hours. --- # TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS You must have: * Reliable high-speed internet * Reliable computer * Quality headset/microphone * Quiet place to make calls * Stable electricity/work environment * Ability to make phone calls throughout your entire shift --- # VOICE RECORDING IS REQUIRED **DO NOT APPLY WITHOUT A VOICE RECORDING.** Applications without a voice recording will not be considered. Please attach or link a **60–90 second voice recording**. In the recording, pretend you are calling a Canadian homeowner named Sarah who filled out a Facebook form asking for a window cleaning quote. Start the conversation exactly how you naturally would on a real sales call. Then briefly explain why you think you would be good at selling over the phone. ### DO NOT: * Use AI-generated audio * Read a long prepared script * Send only a written introduction * Skip the recording We specifically need to hear your **spoken English, confidence, personality, and communication style.** --- # HOW TO APPLY Send: 1. Your name 2. Your location 3. Your previous sales/customer service experience 4. Your expected hourly rate 5. Confirmation that you can work Monday–Saturday, 8 hours per day during Alberta hours 6. Your **60–90 second voice recording** 7. A short answer to: **What was the last thing you sold over the phone, and how did you convince the customer to buy?** Put the words **“OUTWEST SALES”** at the beginning of your application so we know you actually read the posting. We are interviewing immediately and looking to hire quickly. **Again: applications without a voice recording will not be considered.**

title: Lead Sourcing and Research Assistant
description: PART-TIME LEAD RESEARCH & CRM ASSISTANT Business Acquisitions | 10 Hours per Week | Mid to Long-Term Opportunity ABOUT THE ROLE We are a small U.S.-based investment and acquisition group seeking a reliable, detail-oriented research assistant to support our outreach to privately owned businesses, intermediaries, and capital providers. Your primary responsibility will be to find companies that meet specific acquisition criteria, identify their owners or decision-makers, and maintain accurate records in HubSpot. You will also help us stay organized by reviewing outstanding follow-ups, identifying incomplete records, and flagging items that require action. This is initially a research and organization role—not a cold-calling or sales position. RESPONSIBILITIES Company and Contact Research * Build targeted lists of businesses within specified industries and geographic areas. * Determine whether each company genuinely meets our criteria. * Identify company owners, presidents, or other relevant decision-makers. * Find and verify websites, email addresses, telephone numbers, LinkedIn profiles, and other useful information. * Record the sources supporting your research. * Identify potentially attractive businesses and explain why they stand out. HubSpot and Pipeline Organization * Create and update company and contact records in HubSpot. * Check for duplicates before creating new records. * Keep required fields, research notes, and sourcing information complete. * Identify records missing contact information or a clear next step. * Review overdue and upcoming HubSpot tasks. * Prepare a short weekly list of items requiring the principal’s attention. Task and Workflow Support * Use Google Workspace and Google Chat to communicate, share work, and track assigned tasks. * Follow written search criteria and documented procedures. * Ask questions when a company’s qualification is uncertain. * Help improve research procedures as recurring problems or better methods are identified. EXPECTED WEEKLY OUTPUT The initial expectation is approximately 30–40 thoroughly researched, qualified, non-duplicate companies per week. The exact number will depend on the depth and difficulty of the assigned search. Each completed company record should generally include: * Company name * Website * Location * Description of services * Evidence that it meets the search criteria * Owner or decision-maker * Title * Email address, when available * Telephone number * LinkedIn profile, when available * Source links * Relevant notes or uncertainties You will also provide a concise weekly summary showing: * Companies researched and qualified * HubSpot records created or updated * Missing information or unresolved questions * Overdue follow-ups * Items requiring action from the principal * Work prepared for the following week QUALIFICATIONS Required: * Strong online research and investigative skills * Excellent written English * Careful attention to detail * Strong Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel skills * Ability to follow detailed criteria while exercising sound judgment * Ability to distinguish relevant companies from superficially similar businesses * Consistent communication and dependable follow-through * Stable computer and internet connection * Willingness to protect confidential business information * Interest in a stable, long-term working relationship Preferred: * Experience with HubSpot or another CRM * Experience with lead generation, market research, company research, or contact enrichment * Familiarity with LinkedIn and business databases * Experience researching privately owned U.S. businesses * Familiarity with tools used to verify professional email addresses HOURS AND COMPENSATION * Approximately 10 hours per week * Paid weekly * Flexible working hours * One scheduled weekly check-in during U.S. Eastern Time * Initial 30-day paid trial * Opportunity for additional hours and responsibilities based on performance and business needs SELECTION PROCESS Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid research exercise of approximately two hours. The exercise will evaluate research accuracy, judgment, organization, and ability to follow instructions. HOW TO APPLY Begin your application with the words “Blue Ridge Research” so we know you read the entire posting. Please include: 1. A short description of your relevant research or list-building experience. 2. Your experience using HubSpot or another CRM. 3. An anonymized example of a business-research or lead-generation spreadsheet, if available. 4. A description of how you would verify that a company actually repairs or services medical equipment rather than merely selling or distributing it. Please limit your answer to 150 words. 5. Your normal working hours and time zone. 6. Confirmation that you can consistently provide approximately 10 hours per week . We value accuracy, judgment, and reliability more than application length. Please do not submit a long generic cover letter.

title: Part-Time Bookkeeper / Accountant (QuickBooks Online) — US Marketing Agency
job_title: Part-Time Bookkeeper / Accountant (QuickBooks Online) — US Marketing Agency
description: JOB DESCRIPTION: We're a US-based digital marketing agency looking for a reliable, detail-obsessed bookkeeper to own our day-to-day books in QuickBooks Online. This is a long-term, part-time role starting at about 10 hours per week, working directly with our US management team. We are not looking for a data-entry virtual assistant. We're looking for someone who has genuinely maintained US company books and who will tell us when something looks wrong. We would much rather find one person who stays with us for years than cycle through people. WHAT YOU'LL DO Transactions and reconciliation Categorize and match all bank and credit card transactions in QuickBooks Online and Mercury, weekly, without being chased Match incoming client payments to the correct open invoice — this is the single most important part of the job Reconcile payments across multiple rails: QuickBooks, Mercury ACH, and mailed checks. Payments do not always arrive with a notification, and part of this role is noticing money that landed without one Reconcile bank, credit card, and payment-processor accounts monthly Reconcile payroll and contractor payments against our payroll platforms Accounts receivable Create and maintain recurring invoices in QuickBooks Online and Mercury Maintain and tighten QuickBooks invoice reminder automations and invoice follow-up with clients, including for clients whose billing date is not the 1st of the month Maintain an accurate, current picture of what is owed, by whom, and how many days overdue Produce a weekly AR aging report that flags any account approaching our 7-day overdue threshold before it gets there, not after Accounts payable Maintain vendor bills, software subscriptions, and recurring service invoices Track contractor and referral payments through our payment platforms Flag anything approaching its own due date so we are never the late payer Reporting Track client ad spend separately from agency management fees (we will train you on this — the two must never be mixed) Produce a monthly close package: P&L, balance sheet, and a short list of anything unclear or unmatched Flag discrepancies proactively rather than leaving them to sit WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU 3+ years of hands-on bookkeeping experience with US-based companies Strong, current QuickBooks Online skills — this one is non-negotiable Hands-on experience with Mercury or a comparable business banking platform, including ACH payments and failed-payment troubleshooting Comfort setting up and maintaining recurring invoices and automated reminders in QuickBooks Online A working understanding of accrual basis accounting, AR/AP aging, and month-end close Excellent written English — you'll be writing directly to our management team The kind of attention to detail that cannot leave an unmatched transaction alone Reliable internet and a quiet place to work Availability for a short daily overlap with US business hours NICE TO HAVE Experience with ---------- , Deel, or Gusto Experience at an agency, or any business that handles pass-through client funds Accounting degree or CPA — not required, demonstrated experience matters more ABOUT US We are a digital marketing agency. Our clients are licensed, legally operating retail businesses in the regulated cannabis sector in the United States. We do not handle, grow, or sell any product ourselves — we run advertising.
