HOW TO APPLY Please reply with: The word YERBALIST at the top of your message, so we know you read this post The largest set of books you've personally maintained (monthly transaction volume and revenue size is enough — no client names), and how long you've used QuickBooks Online An answer, in your own words, to this: a client sends us $10,000. $8,000 of that is meant to be spent on advertising on their behalf, and $2,000 is our fee. How would you record that, and why does the distinction matter? A short description of how you'd set up a recurring monthly invoice in QuickBooks Online for a client who signed mid-month and owes a prorated amount first Your available hours in US Eastern Time Applications without the code word, or without answers to questions 3 and 4, will not be reviewed.

title: SEO & GEO Strategy Lead-AI Search & Technical SEO
job_title: SEO & GEO Strategy Lead-AI Search & Technical SEO
description: About the Role We are seeking an experienced SEO & GEO Strategy Lead to own and lead our organic search and AI-search strategy. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role for someone who understands both traditional SEO and the rapidly evolving world of Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), AI Search, and answer-engine visibility. The ideal candidate combines deep technical SEO expertise with strong content strategy, authority building, analytics, AI knowledge, leadership, and exceptional organizational skills. This person must be an extremely organized, proactive self-starter who can manage multiple SEO initiatives simultaneously, establish clear priorities, maintain detailed project tracking, lead a small team, and ensure projects move from strategy through execution and measurement. You will be responsible for developing and executing the overall SEO and GEO strategy, identifying opportunities before being asked, and continuously adapting our approach as Google, AI search, and the broader search landscape evolve. Key Responsibilities SEO & Organic Growth Strategy -Own the overall SEO and organic growth strategy -Develop short-, medium-, and long-term SEO roadmaps tied to traffic, visibility, rankings, conversions, and revenue -Identify high-impact opportunities proactively rather than waiting for assignments -Monitor Google algorithm updates, AI-search developments, and changes in SEO best practices -Analyze competitors and identify keyword, content, backlink, technical, and authority gaps -Prioritize initiatives based on expected business impact rather than rankings alone -Create clear strategies and execution plans for both traditional search and AI-driven discovery -Work closely with marketing, content, development, merchandising, and e-commerce teams Technical SEO Own and continuously improve technical SEO across the website, including: -Site architecture and crawlability -Indexation -XML sitemaps -Robots.txt -Canonicalization -Redirects -Duplicate-content management -Internal linking architecture --Core Web Vitals -Page speed -Mobile SEO -JavaScript SEO -Structured data and ---------- markup -Product, category, article, FAQ, organization, breadcrumb, and other applicable schema -Faceted navigation and URL parameter management -Technical SEO audits and implementation roadmaps The candidate must be comfortable identifying technical issues, understanding their business impact, prioritizing fixes, and working directly with developers to ensure proper implementation. GEO & AI Search Strategy Develop and lead our Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and AI Search strategy. Responsibilities include: -Improve brand and content visibility within AI-powered search and answer engines -Understand how traditional SEO signals interact with AI-generated answers and recommendations -Structure content so it can be easily understood, referenced, and surfaced by search engines and AI systems -Develop strategies around entities, topical authority, structured data, citations, brand mentions, and authoritative sources -Evaluate how AI platforms are discovering, understanding, and referencing our brand and competitors -Identify opportunities to improve visibility across conversational and AI-powered search experiences -Monitor the evolution of GEO, answer-engine optimization, and AI search -Test emerging strategies and measure which tactics create meaningful business results -Separate meaningful developments from short-lived SEO or AI trends -The candidate should understand that GEO is an evolving discipline and be comfortable testing, measuring, learning, and adapting quickly as the ecosystem changes. AI & Automation We want someone who actively and intelligently uses AI as part of their daily SEO workflow. The candidate should understand how to use AI tools to improve the speed and quality of: Keyword and topic research Content briefs SERP analysis Competitor research Content-gap analysis Internal-linking analysis Schema development and validation SEO audits Content optimization Data analysis Reporting Research Workflow automation Process efficiency We are not looking for someone who simply uses AI to generate articles. The successful candidate will understand how to use AI strategically while maintaining quality, originality, accuracy, search intent, brand authority, and editorial standards. On-Page SEO & Content Strategy -Develop keyword strategies based on search intent, competition, opportunity, and business value -Optimize product pages, category pages, landing pages, and informational content -Build scalable internal-linking strategies -Optimize titles, meta descriptions, headings, copy, URLs, images, and structured content -Conduct content-gap and competitor analyses -Develop topic clusters and topical-authority strategies -Create and manage an SEO-focused blog and content roadmap -Provide detailed SEO briefs to writers and content teams -Audit existing content and determine what should be improved, consolidated, redirected, expanded, or removed -Ensure content supports both traditional SEO and emerging GEO objectives Off-Page SEO & Authority Building -Develop and manage a sustainable authority-building strategy that includes: -Backlink acquisition -Digital PR -Guest posting -Relevant industry placements -Brand mentions -Partnerships -Link-gap analysis -Competitor backlink analysis -Outreach strategies -Identification of high-quality authoritative websites The candidate must understand the difference between high-quality authority building and low-quality or spam-based link building and protect the company from tactics that could create long-term SEO risk. Analytics & Performance Must have strong working knowledge of: Google Analytics 4 (GA4) Google Search Console Ahrefs Semrush The candidate must be able to use data to identify opportunities, diagnose problems, measure performance, and make strategic decisions. Key metrics may include: Organic revenue Organic traffic Non-branded search growth Rankings and search visibility Impressions Click-through rate Conversions Indexed pages Crawl health Backlink quality and authority Content performance AI Search / GEO visibility Brand mentions and citations within AI-generated results This role is expected to go beyond reporting numbers. The Strategy Lead should be able to explain: What happened? Why did it happen? What does the data tell us? What should we do next? Organization, Project Management & Execution Exceptional organization is a critical requirement for this position. The successful candidate must be able to: Manage numerous SEO, content, technical, GEO, and backlink initiatives simultaneously Maintain a clearly prioritized SEO roadmap and project calendar Break strategies into specific tasks, owners, deadlines, and measurable outcomes Maintain detailed documentation of projects, tests, findings, decisions, and results Create repeatable processes and SOPs for the SEO team Track projects from initial concept through implementation and measurement Follow up proactively with developers, writers, designers, agencies, and other stakeholders Keep the team organized and accountable to deadlines Run highly organized weekly SEO meetings with clear priorities and action items Distinguish between urgent issues, high-impact opportunities, and lower-priority work Communicate project status, roadblocks, results, and next steps clearly to management Ensure recommendations are actually implemented rather than remaining in reports or audits We are looking for someone who creates structure rather than someone who needs structure created for them. Leadership & Team Management This position will lead a small SEO/content team and coordinate with other departments and external partners. Responsibilities include: Set strategic priorities and quarterly objectives Translate strategy into clear execution plans Assign and review work Create accountability across projects and team members Coach and develop team members Manage freelancers, agencies, or external SEO resources when needed Review quality of technical SEO, content, backlink, and GEO work Ensure projects move from recommendation to implementation Communicate SEO priorities clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders Hold team members and partners accountable for deadlines and results Required Qualifications 5+ years of hands-on SEO experience Strong technical SEO expertise Strong understanding of on-page and off-page SEO Demonstrated experience developing SEO strategy, not simply executing tasks Exceptional organizational and project-management skills Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, deadlines, and team members simultaneously Strong knowledge of Google Search Console and GA4 Advanced working knowledge of Ahrefs and Semrush Experience with structured data and schema markup Experience developing and managing blog and content strategies Experience with backlink acquisition, guest posting, outreach, and authority building Experience conducting technical SEO audits Experience working with developers on SEO implementations Strong understanding of AI-powered search, GEO, and the changing search landscape Practical experience using AI tools within SEO workflows Experience leading or managing a small team Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Strong strategic thinking and prioritization skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills What We're Looking For We want someone who is a highly organized, proactive self-starter, strong strategist, and effective leader. You should naturally ask: What opportunities are we missing? Why are competitors outranking us? What has changed in Google or AI search? Where are the biggest technical SEO opportunities? What should we test next? What will have the greatest impact on organic revenue? Who owns the next action, when is it due, and how will we measure whether it worked? You should not need management to continually identify opportunities, establish your priorities, organize your workload, or follow up on unfinished projects. We are looking for someone who takes ownership. The right person will continuously study changes in Google Search, AI search, GEO, SEO technology, consumer search behavior, and industry best practices, translate those developments into actionable strategies, and ensure those strategies are executed successfully. Success in This Role Success means building a well-organized, measurable, and scalable organic-growth engine that improves visibility across both traditional search and the emerging AI-search ecosystem. We are looking for someone who can combine strategy, technical SEO, content, authority building, analytics, AI, leadership, organization, and disciplined execution to produce measurable business growth. title: SEO Writer
description: About AuctionTimepieces AuctionTimepieces (ATP) is a fee-free auction and marketplace platform for luxury watches. For decades, the watch market has run on middlemen, hidden margins, and opaque pricing. We're building the transparent alternative: a place where serious buyers and sellers of Patek Philippe, Audemars Piguet, Richard Mille, Rolex, and beyond can transact directly and with confidence. We're early, which means you won't inherit someone else's mess. You'll build our organic search presence from the ground up, and you'll own it. The Role We're hiring one person to own everything organic: technical SEO, content strategy, and the copy that runs across the site. You'll d ---------- what we rank for, build the pages and systems that get us there, and write the words that turn search traffic into bidders and sellers. This is a hands-on role for someone who can run a crawl audit in the morning and write a sharp category page in the afternoon. What You'll Own Technical SEO Site architecture and crawlability for a marketplace where inventory changes constantly, including internal linking that pushes authority to the pages that matter. The auction lifecycle. D ---------- how live, ended, and sold listings are handled: what stays indexed, what redirects, and how sold results become permanent, rankable price-history assets. Faceted navigation (brand, model, reference, year, condition, price) built so it helps users without creating duplicate content or crawl traps. Structured data (Product, Offer, Breadcrumb, Organization, FAQ, and auction/event markup where applicable) and rich result eligibility. Performance: Core Web Vitals, mobile experience, and image optimization for high-resolution watch photography. Developer partnership: write clear tickets, QA releases, and catch SEO regressions before they ship. Keyword & Content Strategy A keyword map built around how collectors actually search: reference numbers (15500ST, 5711/1A), model names and nicknames, "price," "for sale," "auction results," and "vs." comparisons. Scaled page templates for brand hubs, model and reference pages, and sold-price archives, built with enough unique value that they rank rather than read as thin. An editorial calendar covering buying guides, authentication guides, reference deep-dives, market reports, and comparison content on fee-free selling versus traditional auction house and marketplace fees. Visibility in AI-driven search (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and similar) alongside traditional rankings. Copywriting All core site copy: homepage, how it works, selling and consigning, brand and category pages, FAQs, and trust and authentication pages. On-page optimization across the site, including title tags, meta descriptions, headers, and image alt text. Listing standards. Set the SEO rules for listing titles and descriptions, and work with our listing-description workflow so every listing is search-friendly and on-brand. Brand voice. Write in a way that feels premium, knowledgeable, and credible to serious collectors. No generic e-commerce filler. Authority & Links Earn links and mentions from horology publications, watch blogs, collector communities, and press. Build the trust and expertise signals a platform handling high-value transactions needs to rank and convert. Monitor and maintain a clean backlink profile. Measurement & Reporting Own GA4, Google Search Console, and SEO tooling (Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, or equivalents). Report monthly to the founders on rankings, organic traffic, and indexation, and, most importantly, on organic sign-ups, bids, and seller leads. Track competitors including Chrono24, Bezel, Phillips, and eBay. What Success Looks Like First 30 days: A full technical and content audit of ---------- , a competitor gap analysis, and a prioritized roadmap. First 90 days: Technical foundations fixed and live, keyword map complete, core pages rewritten, scaled brand/model/reference page templates shipped, and a consistent publishing cadence running. 6 to 12 months: Clear growth in non-branded organic traffic, first-page rankings for priority brand, model, and reference terms, and organic search established as a real source of registered bidders and seller leads.

title: Operations Coordinator
description: ABOUT THE ROLE Simply Roofing is a US-based residential and commercial roofing company (Arizona & Texas). That said, this is not a script-reading call center job and it is not lead-scraping. You will email and speak with US business buyers directly, under your own name, as part of our company - you are just doing it with an experienced person behind you rather than alone. You will have to think on your feet, answer real questions about a real product, and be persistent without being annoying. We need someone US buyers understand easily and take seriously on the phone. WHO YOU WORK WITH You report to and work alongside our senior salesperson. He has spent his career in this industry. He takes the meetings, handles the pricing negotiations, and closes the deals. You are the person who makes sure he walks into every week with a full list of the right companies to talk to, that every quote he sent has been followed up on, and that nothing sits waiting on him without you flagging it. When he is on the road or on calls all day, you are the one keeping his pipeline moving. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Run outbound outreach. Write and send introduction emails in professional US business English, and work a structured follow-up sequence. You write these yourself; we give you the framework and the product knowledge. - Get on the phone. Call prospects who have not replied, call the ones who have, qualify what they buy and how much, and hand the real opportunities to your salesperson with a proper introduction and a briefing on what you learned. Expect this to be a real part of your day, every day. - Qualify properly. Find out what grade and volume they use, who they buy from now, what they pay, when their contracts renew, and what would make them switch - and write all of it down. - Prepare quotes and chase them. Build price quotes from our pricing sheet for your salesperson to review, send them out, and follow up on every open quote on a schedule until we get a yes or a no. Most sales are lost to silence, not to a competitor - preventing that silence is one of the main reasons this job exists. - Coordinate samples. Get product samples out to prospects and follow up on the results - this is often the step that turns interest into an order. - Own the pipeline records. Keep the CRM current: every contact, every conversation, every next step, with dates. Send a short written end-of-day summary of what moved, what is stuck, and what needs your salesperson's attention tomorrow. He should never have to ask you where something stands. - See the first order through. When an account says yes, you stay with it: confirm the order details, pass them to our logistics team to get the truck scheduled, and keep the customer informed until it is delivered. You are not booking freight and you are not doing the invoicing - you are making sure the customer's first experience with us is a good one. REQUIREMENTS - Excellent spoken English with a neutral, easily understood accent. This is a hard requirement - you will be on the phone with US buyers, and it is the first thing we screen for. - Excellent written English. Your emails go to US business customers with no one editing them first. - At least 3 years in B2B sales, inside sales, appointment setting, sales support, or account management for US or other Western clients. Outbound experience specifically - not inbound support only. - Genuinely comfortable making cold calls to people who are not expecting you, and comfortable being told no repeatedly without losing momentum. - Organized to the point of being annoying about it. This job is mostly follow-up, and follow-up is where most salespeople lose deals. You are the safety net for someone else's pipeline as well as your own work. - Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet place to take calls, and a working headset. NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED) - Experience selling an industrial, chemical, or raw-material product, or selling into manufacturing plants. - Experience with a CRM (HubSpot, Zoho, Pipedrive, or similar). - Any exposure to US freight or full-truckload shipping - useful for talking intelligently about delivery, though you will not be booking trucks. WHAT WE OFFER - $1,600 - $2,000 USD per month, paid twice monthly, direct - no agency taking a cut. - Performance bonus on closed business once you are past ramp - we will define it in writing with you at 90 days. - A raise review at 90 days and again at one year, based on results. - Paid Philippine holidays, and paid time off after 90 days. - Long-term, stable work, and a real industry education - you will learn this business from someone who has spent a career in it. As we grow, this seat grows with it. - Direct access to both the owner and the salesperson you support. No layers, no bureaucracy - if you bring us a real opportunity, we act on it that day. HOW TO APPLY - READ CAREFULLY We read every application that follows the instructions. Applications that do not follow them are deleted unread, because following written instructions precisely is most of this job. 1. Begin your reply with the word GRAPHITE in all capitals on the first line, by itself. 2. Record a voice clip of 60-90 seconds at ---------- and paste the link in your application. In the clip, in English: introduce yourself, then give us the actual opening you would use on a cold call to a US manufacturing company you have never spoken to before - the first 30 seconds, word for word, as you would really say it. You are calling to find out what they buy and to open the door for your salesperson, not to close anything. Do not read a prepared script; we can hear it, and we will pass. Applications without a voice clip will not be considered. 3. Answer these three questions in writing. Short and specific beats long and general. Question 1. Tell us about a prospect you personally followed up with more than four times before getting a result. What did you say differently each time, and how did it end? If it ended in a no, tell us that - a clean no is a useful answer. Question 2. You finally reach the buyer at a company that uses exactly what we sell. He says: "We've been buying from the same supplier for eleven years, we're happy, and I'm not looking to change." What do you say next - actually write the words - and what do you do with that account over the following six months to keep it warm for your salesperson? Question 3. Tell us about your experience with AI, what specific AI technologies you use and how you use them, and the most complex project you have used AI with.

description: E-Commerce Shopify Supply Chain Operations Manager Salary Range: $5 USD per hour, depending on experience Work Schedule: Part-time | Remote | around 24 hours per week | at least 4 hours of daily overlap with CEST (Amsterdam) Experience Required: At least 1 year in eCommerce Supply Chain, Fulfillment, Order Management, or Operations About the Role We are an international eCommerce company operating multiple Shopify-based stores. We are looking for a highly organized and proactive Supply Chain Operations Manager to take ownership of our day-to-day supply chain and order operations. You will be responsible for making sure orders move smoothly from purchase to delivery, resolving fulfillment and supplier issues, performing regular quality checks, and identifying problems or risks that need to be flagged to management. This role requires someone who takes ownership, follows up consistently, and pays close attention to detail. You should not only resolve issues when they happen, but also identify recurring problems, check that processes are being followed correctly, and help prevent operational issues from happening again. Key Responsibilities - Take ownership of order and fulfillment issues, including out-of-stock, delayed, lost, damaged, incorrect, not-received, and returned orders. - Monitor open and blocked orders and ensure they are followed up on until fully resolved. - Handle and follow up on Return to China (RTC) and Return to Sender (RTS) cases. - Coordinate with suppliers and other partners to resolve fulfillment, product, and shipping issues. - Work closely with Customer Support on order-related cases requiring Supply Chain action. - Review and process refunds accurately according to internal SOPs and policies. - Monitor outbound orders, tracking updates, and other order exceptions requiring action. - Perform regular quality checks to make sure orders, refunds, tracking, and internal processes are being handled correctly. - Identify mistakes, recurring issues, unusual patterns, or operational risks and flag important findings to the Backend Manager. - Check that internal SOPs and processes are being followed consistently and report when something is missing or not working correctly. - Identify supplier, product, shipping, or fulfillment issues that could lead to increased refunds, complaints, disputes, or chargebacks. - Maintain accurate order statuses, tracking information, refund records, and internal notes. - Maintain clear follow-ups on all open Supply Chain cases until they are fully resolved. - Help document and improve Supply Chain SOPs, quality-control procedures, and workflows. - Use Shopify, Google Sheets, Re:amaze, Notion, and other internal tools to manage and monitor Supply Chain operations. Qualifications - Minimum 1 year of relevant experience in eCommerce supply chain, fulfillment, order management, or operations. - Experience working with Shopify-based eCommerce stores. - Good understanding of order fulfillment, shipping, tracking, refunds, returns, and supplier-related issues. - Strong attention to detail and ability to spot errors, inconsistencies, and operational risks. - Strong problem-solving skills and ability to independently follow issues through to resolution. - Comfortable working with Shopify, Google Sheets, Notion, and helpdesk/order management tools. - Able to perform structured quality checks and clearly report findings to management. - Organized and capable of managing multiple open cases and priorities at the same time. - Proactive and willing to escalate important issues rather than waiting for someone else to notice them. - Strong written and spoken English. - Reliable internet connection and ability to work at least 4 hours of daily overlap with CEST (Amsterdam). Preferred Skills - Experience working with multiple Shopify or dropshipping stores. - Experience communicating directly with suppliers or fulfillment partners. - Experience handling RTC, RTS, lost shipments, delayed orders, and other fulfillment exceptions. - Experience performing operational quality checks or audits. - Experience managing refund and order-tracking sheets. - Understanding of how fulfillment and operational issues can lead to complaints, refunds, disputes, and chargebacks. - Experience identifying recurring problems and improving SOPs or workflows. What We Offer - $5 USD per hour, depending on experience. - Around 24 hours per week with the opportunity to grow as the role develops. - Long-term and stable position. - Salary reviews every 6 months and clear room to grow. - An important role in improving and scaling our Supply Chain operations. - Supportive international team, regular feedback, paid training, and clear SOPs. How to Apply Please send the following: - Who you are, in 2–3 sentences, and your most relevant experience with eCommerce supply chain, fulfillment, or order operations. - One example of a difficult operational or fulfillment issue you identified and resolved, and how you handled it. - Subject line: "Application – Supply Chain Operations Manager (Your Name)"

description: # Executive Assistant & Operations Coordinator **Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | U.S. Pacific Time Hours** We are looking for an exceptionally organized, proactive, and tech-savvy Executive Assistant & Operations Coordinator to work directly with the founders of a growing beauty company and support our broader creative and operational team. This is not a traditional administrative assistant role. We are looking for someone who can become a true operational right hand—someone who keeps information organized, connects the dots between team members, follows up without being asked, uses technology and AI to work efficiently, and helps ensure that things don't fall through the cracks. Our business operates across beauty, e-commerce, social media, TikTok Shop, content creation, product development, and professional hairstyling. There are a lot of moving pieces, so we're looking for someone who enjoys bringing structure to a fast-moving creative environment. ### What You'll Help With Your responsibilities will evolve as you learn the business, but may include: * Managing and prioritizing emails, including flagging what requires founder attention and drafting responses * Calendar management, scheduling, appointments, meetings, travel, and reminders * Acting as a connector between founders, employees, freelancers, vendors, and other partners * Following up with team members on projects, deadlines, deliverables, and unanswered questions * Helping manage our social media and video team, including keeping content and deliverables moving * Maintaining project trackers, calendars, SOPs, databases, and internal documentation * Running recurring weekly and monthly reports across e-commerce, social media, TikTok Shop, email marketing, and other areas of the business * Organizing data and turning it into simple, easy-to-understand summaries * Conducting research and presenting clear recommendations rather than simply sending links * Researching, sourcing, communicating with, and comparing vendors * Assisting with customer-service questions and escalations when needed * Scheduling or posting social content and assisting with community engagement when needed * Organizing files, assets, product information, contacts, and company resources * Preparing meeting agendas, taking notes, documenting decisions, and following up on action items * Helping build and maintain systems that make the company more efficient * Using AI and automation tools to streamline repetitive tasks and improve workflows * Handling miscellaneous operational and executive-assistant projects as they arise ### Who We're Looking For You are someone who is extremely organized but also comfortable working in a creative, entrepreneurial environment where priorities can change quickly. You don't need to know everything on day one. More important is that you're resourceful enough to figure things out. The ideal person: * Is proactive and doesn't need to be micromanaged * Has excellent written and spoken English * Communicates clearly and professionally * Has strong attention to detail * Is comfortable following up with people and holding team members accountable * Can distinguish between something they can solve themselves and something that truly needs founder input * Is excellent at internet research and information organization * Is comfortable working with spreadsheets and reporting * Is highly comfortable with technology * Already uses AI tools such as ChatGPT or is excited to become highly proficient with them * Enjoys creating systems, processes, templates, and organization * Can handle confidential business and personal information professionally * Is comfortable learning new software quickly * Has experience supporting executives, founders, e-commerce businesses, agencies, or fast-moving startups Experience with platforms such as Google Workspace, Slack, Shopify, TikTok Shop, Klaviyo, social media platforms, project-management software, and e-commerce reporting is a plus, but we care more about intelligence, resourcefulness, and willingness to learn than knowing every platform already. ### Schedule This is a **full-time remote position based in the Philippines**, working hours that substantially overlap with our U.S.-based team. Candidates must be comfortable working a night-shift schedule aligned with U.S. Pacific Time. We are looking for someone who wants to become deeply integrated into the business and grow with us—not someone balancing several full-time clients simultaneously. ### What Success Looks Like Within the first few months, you should understand our business well enough that the founders are spending less time chasing information, coordinating people, checking whether things were completed, searching for documents, scheduling, researching, and handling routine operational questions. Ultimately, we want you to become someone the team can go to first—allowing the founders to spend more time on creative direction, content, product development, hairstyling, and the areas of the business that require their direct involvement. ### To Apply Please send: 1. A brief introduction and your relevant experience 2. Your experience supporting founders, executives, or small businesses 3. The software and AI tools you currently use 4. An example of a system, process, or workflow you improved in a previous role 5. Your expected monthly salary in USD 6. Confirmation that you are comfortable working U.S. Pacific Time hours Please also begin your application with the word **TRADEMARK** so we know you've read the full posting.
